title: 六级核心词汇
subtitle: ECDICT cet6 标签词表，去除四级及已收录词后按词频排序

defsEn: n. someone who is skilled at analyzing data
n. an expert who studies financial data (on credit or securities or sales or financial patterns etc.) and recommends appropriate business actions
n. a licensed practitioner of psychoanalysis
zh: n. 分析者, 精神分析学家
examples: Some analysts consider Somalia as the failed state par excellence.
The analyst collated the data and prepared a report.
exampleZh: 一些分析家认为索马里是非常失败的国家。

defsEn: n. standing or position on a scale
zh: n. 等级, 额定功率, 责骂
examples: I like to see the ratings going up.

defsEn: n. someone who finds financing for and supervises the making and presentation of a show (play or film or program or similar work)
n. something that produces
zh: n. 生产者, 制作者, 制作人
examples: Austria is one of the largest producers of electricity in Europe.
He left the producer a message on voice mail.
exampleZh: 奥地利在欧洲是最大的电能生产国之一。

defsEn: r. in distinction from others
zh: adv. 特定地, 明确地, 按特性
examples: What specifically do you need me to do?
How did you specifically choose this spot here, in the middle of nowhere?

defsEn: n. a message informing of danger
n. notification of something, usually in advance
zh: n. 警告, 预告, 预兆, 通知
examples: He ignored all of our warnings.
She paid no heed to our warnings.
exampleZh: 他不顾我们的一再劝告。
她不把我们的警告放在心上。

defsEn: n. either side of the body below the waist and above the thigh
n. the ball-and-socket joint between the head of the femur and the acetabulum
n. (architecture) the exterior angle formed by the junction of a sloping side and a sloping end of a roof
n. the fruit of a rose plant
zh: n. 臀部, 蔷薇果, 忧郁
a. 熟悉内情的
vt. 使忧郁, 给(屋顶)造屋脊
interj. 喝彩声
examples: The man wore a gun on his hip.
Pain over the hip joint could mean bursitis.

defsEn: n the excess of revenues over outlays in a given period of time (including depreciation and other non-cash expenses)
n something that remunerates
v earn on some commercial or business transaction
earn as salary or wages
v acquire or deserve by one's efforts or actions
zh: n. 所赚的钱, 工资, 收入
examples: Our earnings are in proportion to our real ability.
I spent all of this month's earnings from my part-time job on clothes.

defsEn: n. bulbous herb of southern Europe widely naturalized
bulb breaks up into separate strong-flavored cloves
n. aromatic bulb used as seasoning
zh: n. 大蒜
examples: I like garlic but, because of the smell, I rarely eat it.
This dish has a bit of garlic flavor.
exampleZh: 虽然我喜欢大蒜，但因为很臭，所以很少吃。
这道菜里有点大蒜的味道。

defsEn: a. relating to or befitting athletics or athletes
s. having a sturdy and well proportioned body
zh: a. 运动的
examples: The athletic meeting will be put off.
The boy put on his athletic shoes and ran outside.
exampleZh: 运动会要延期举行。
那个男孩穿上了他的运动鞋，跑向外面。

defsEn: n. a high-speed military or naval airplane designed to destroy enemy aircraft in the air
zh: n. 斗士, 战士, 好战者, 战斗机
examples: The fire fighters put out the fire.
I want to be a fire fighter.
exampleZh: 消防队员把火扑灭了。

defsEn: n. the civilization of Muslims collectively which is governed by the Muslim religion
n. the monotheistic religious system of Muslims founded in Arabia in the 7th century and based on the teachings of Muhammad as laid down in the Koran
zh: n. 伊斯兰教
examples: Tom converted from Christianity to Islam.
Islam will show you the right path in life.
exampleZh: 汤姆从基督教改宗到伊斯兰教了。

defsEn: n a person whose occupation is teaching
zh: n. 教员, 讲师
examples: My driving instructor says I should be more patient.
I know an English language instructor who comes from Canada.
exampleZh: 我的驾驶导师说我应该耐心一点。
我认识一个加拿大来的英语教师。

defsEn: n the contestant you hope to defeat
zh: n. 竞争者
examples: She's a tough competitor, isn't she?
He might see you as a competitor.
exampleZh: 她是强大的对手，不是吗？

defsEn: n. the state of being pregnant
the period from conception to birth when a woman carries a developing fetus in her uterus
zh: n. 怀孕；丰富, 多产；意义深长
examples: I need this for a pregnancy test.
Pregnancy will stretch out your belly button.

defsEn: n. a senior member of the Christian clergy having spiritual and administrative authority
appointed in Christian churches to oversee priests or ministers
considered in some churches to be successors of the twelve Apostles of Christ
n. port wine mulled with oranges and cloves
n. (chess) a piece that can be moved diagonally over unoccupied squares of the same color
zh: n. 主教, (国际象棋中的)象, 热果子酒
examples: The bishop saw them at church.
A bishop can never end up on an opposite-colored square.

defsEn: a. of or relating to the philosophical study of ethics
a. conforming to accepted standards of social or professional behavior
s. adhering to ethical and moral principles
zh: a. 伦理的, 民族的, 民族特有的
examples: Would it be ethical to sacrifice one person to save many?
I think it might not be ethical to do that.
exampleZh: 为了救许多人牺牲一个人是否道德？

defsEn: n. a reciprocal relation between two or more things
n. a statistical relation between two or more variables such that systematic changes in the value of one variable are accompanied by systematic changes in the other
zh: n. 相互关系, 相关, 关联
examples: I'm unable to grasp the correlation between these two things.
Edmundo found the correlation between the signal and what the aliens were doing.

defsEn: v overcome, as with emotions or perceptual stimuli
v charge someone with too many tasks
v cover completely or make imperceptible
v overcome by superior force
s so strong as to be irresistible
s very intense
zh: a. 压倒性的, 无法抵抗的
examples: I know how overwhelming it can all get.
Their need for attention can be overwhelming.

defsEn: n. a message issued in behalf of some product or cause or idea or person or institution
n. act of raising in rank or position
n. encouragement of the progress or growth or acceptance of something
zh: n. 晋级, 创建, 增进
examples: James Cameron personally did the official promotion!
Do you want to be on the promotion track?
exampleZh: 卡神亲自官宣！

defsEn: n. a tight or amorous embrace
v. fit closely or tightly
zh: n. 紧抱, 拥抱
vt. 紧抱, 坚持, 使沾沾自喜
examples: I just want to hug you.
Can I give you a hug?
exampleZh: 我只想抱你。
我能抱你吗？

defsEn: n. to travel for the purpose of discovery
n. a careful systematic search
n. a systematic consideration
zh: n. 探险, 踏勘, 探测
examples: Space exploration may be robotic in nature for a long time yet.
Adolescence can lead to exploration of identity.

defsEn: n. an ordered array of the components of an emission or wave
n. a broad range of related objects or values or qualities or ideas or activities
zh: n. 光谱, 范围, 系列
examples: I think I'm on the ace spectrum.
The number of legs in humans is on a spectrum.

defsEn: n skillfulness by virtue of possessing special knowledge
zh: n. 专家意见, 专门技术
examples: We have a lot of expertise in this area.
A lawyer's expertise will help me understand the legal implications of my situation thoroughly.

defsEn: n. a person who receives something
zh: a. 领受的, 容易接受的, 感受性强的
n. 领受者, 容纳者, 容器
examples: Don't flip-flop the addresses of the sender and recipient!
Trust me, people who were the recipient of my wrath, remember it very well.
exampleZh: 不要把寄件人、收件人地址的姓名填反了！

defsEn: a. relating to or characteristic of diplomacy
a. using or marked by tact in dealing with sensitive matters or people
zh: a. 外交的, 老练的
examples: South Korea established diplomatic relations with Syria.
They have to learn diplomatic protocol.
exampleZh: 韩国与叙利亚建立外交关系。

defsEn: v. make small or insignificant
v. cause to seem less serious
play down
zh: vt. 将...减到最少
vt. 最小化
vi. 最小化
examples: We need to minimize the risk of infection.
We need to minimize the risk.

defsEn: a. refined and tasteful in appearance or behavior or style
s. suggesting taste, ease, and wealth
s. displaying effortless beauty and simplicity in movement or execution
zh: a. 优雅的, 端庄的, 高雅的
examples: Bring one elegant dress to go to the theater or to a party.
I want to buy this elegant lipstick. It looks so beautiful!

defsEn: n. the act of preventing
zh: n. 阻止, 妨碍, 预防
examples: The prevention of forest fires is everyone's responsibility.
Prevention is better than a cure.
exampleZh: 防止山火，人人有责。

defsEn: n. the intended meaning of a communication
zh: n. 意图, 含义, 故意
a. 专心的, 决心的, 热心的
examples: Listen with the intent to understand, not the intent to reply.
Intent to destroy is a key part of the crime of genocide.

defsEn: n. a detailed list of all the items in stock
n. (accounting) the value of a firm's current assets including raw materials and work in progress and finished goods
n. making an itemized list of merchandise or supplies on hand
v. make or include in an itemized record or report
zh: n. 详细目录, 存货清单
vt. 列入详细目录, 清点存货
examples: Keep an inventory of what's on the shelves to prevent over-purchasing.
It won't all fit in my inventory.

defsEn: n. the property of relative size or extent (whether large or small)
n. relative importance
zh: n. 巨大, 重大, 重要, 大小, 数量, 星等(指星的亮度)
examples: You need to understand the magnitude of the problem.
No one could believe the magnitude of the tragedy.

defsEn: n. the quality of being widely admired or accepted or sought after
zh: n. 名声, 受大众欢迎, 流行
examples: The popularity of a web site depends on its content.
Popularity has nothing to do with it.

defsEn: v. transfer property or ownership
s. not contained in or deriving from the essential nature of something
s. being or from or characteristic of another place or part of the world
zh: n. 外国人, 外侨
a. 外国的, 相异的
examples: I swear, I saw an alien!
Do you think there are aliens?
exampleZh: 我发誓我看到了外星人。
你觉着有外星人存在吗？

defsEn: n. the act of taking and printing photographs
n. the process of producing images of objects on photosensitive surfaces
n. the occupation of taking and printing photographs or making movies
zh: n. 摄影, 摄影术
examples: I have an interest in photography.
Photography takes me back to my childhood.
exampleZh: 我对摄影感兴趣。

defsEn: n. a group of persons together in one place
zh: n. 聚集, 集中, 采集
examples: Family gatherings seem foreign to me now.
Traditional Thanksgiving gatherings seem custom-made to spread the coronavirus.

defsEn: n. the group of languages derived from Latin
n. a novel dealing with idealized events remote from everyday life
v. have a love affair with
v. tell romantic or exaggerated lies
zh: n. 冒险故事, 浪漫史, 传奇文学
vi. 写传奇, 作空想, 虚构
examples: Can you recommend a romance novel for me?
The Romanian language is part of the Romance language family.
exampleZh: 有什么言情小说推荐吗？
罗马尼亚语属于罗曼语族。

defsEn: n. a case for containing a set of articles
n. gear consisting of a set of articles or tools for a specified purpose
n. young of any of various fur-bearing animals
zh: n. 装备, 工具箱, 成套工具
examples: The first-aid kit is under the driving seat.
There's a survival kit in that closet.

defsEn: r. without missing a year
zh: adv. 一年一次, 每年
examples: Annually we work on our land.
The meeting will be held annually.

defsEn: n. farm consisting of a large tract of land along with facilities needed to raise livestock (especially cattle)
v. manage or run a ranch
zh: n. 大牧场
v. 经营牧场
examples: I found a nice ranch house.
At the ranch they found two women, a mother and her daughter.

defsEn: s. communicated in the form of words
a. of or relating to or formed from words in general
a. of or relating to or formed from a verb
a. relating to or having facility in the use of words
zh: a. 用言辞的, 言语的, 口头的, 逐字的, 动词的
examples: I don't need your verbal gentleness.
We place an emphasis on verbal practice from the very first classes.
exampleZh: 我不需要你口头上的温柔。

defsEn: a. of or relating to a coast
a. located on or near or bordering on a coast
zh: a. 海岸的, 沿海的, 沿岸的
examples: Chinese coastal cities are generally more developed than the inland ones.
In Devon we have wonderful coastal walking.
exampleZh: 中国大陆的沿海城市普遍比内陆城市发达。

defsEn: n. tender, romantic, or nostalgic feeling or emotion
zh: n. 感情, 感伤, 情操, 情绪, 感想, 意见
examples: Anti-Chinese sentiment is on the rise in Myanmar.
You have the same sentiments as the maid.
exampleZh: 缅甸反华情绪正在增长。

defsEn: v. perceive intuitively or through some inexplicable perceptive powers
v. search by divining, as if with a rod
s. emanating from God
s. being or having the nature of a god
'tis God-like to create"-J.G.Saxe
zh: a. 神的, 神圣的, 非凡的
n. 神学家
examples: To err is human, to forgive divine.
I read the book "The Divine Comedy".
exampleZh: 人皆有错，唯圣者能恕。

defsEn: n. arousal of the mind to special unusual activity or creativity
n. a product of your creative thinking and work
n. a sudden intuition as part of solving a problem
zh: n. 灵感, 鼓舞人心的人或物, 妙计, 吸气
examples: My mother was an angel and an inspiration to me.
Suddenly she had a brilliant inspiration.
exampleZh: 我的母亲是一位天使，也是我的灵感来源。
她突然有了一个绝妙的灵感。

defsEn: n. the act of searching for something
v. make a search (for)
v. search the trail of (game)
v. seek alms, as for religious purposes
zh: n. 探索, 寻求, 调查
v. 寻找, 找, 追寻猎物
examples: Gulliver traveled in quest of adventure.
The quest for knowledge fuels our curiosity and understanding.
exampleZh: 格列佛为寻求探险而旅行。

defsEn: n. an attempt to get something
n. a formal proposal to buy at a specified price
n. (bridge) the number of tricks a bridge player is willing to contract to make
v. ask for or request earnestly
zh: n. 出价
v. 命令, 吩咐, 请求, 表示, 宣布, 投标
examples: I bid you greetings and may there be peace through fellowship between us.
Please bid farewell, my Lady, to your husband.
exampleZh: 我向你们致以问候，愿我们之间的友谊带来和平。

defsEn: n. a blow from a flat object (as an open hand)
v. hit with something flat, like a paddle or the open hand
zh: n. 掴, 掌击, 侮辱, 拍击声
v. 拍击, 惩罚
adv. 正面地, 直接地, 突然地
examples: She gave him a slap in the face.
She slapped him in the face.
exampleZh: 她打了他一巴掌。
她打了他一巴掌。

defsEn: a. of or relating to or caused by a toxin or poison
zh: a. 有毒的, 中毒的
examples: Toxic people drag other people down to their level.
Toxic people like to spread their misery around.

defsEn: n. intense sorrow caused by loss of a loved one (especially by death)
n. something that causes great unhappiness
zh: n. 伤心, 忧愁, 悲痛, 不幸, 灾难
examples: She was filled with deep grief to hear of her father's sudden death.
They cause me a lot of grief.
exampleZh: 她得知父亲突然离世，不禁心如刀割。

defsEn: n. the person who plays that position on a football team
n. (American football) a position on the line of scrimmage
n. (American football) grasping an opposing player with the intention of stopping by throwing to the ground
v. seize and throw down an opponent player, who usually carries the ball
zh: n. 工具, 复滑车, 滑车, 装备, 扭倒
vt. 固定, 处理, 抓住
vi. 扭倒
examples: To begin with, we must tackle the problem.
How do you tackle a translation project?
exampleZh: 首先我们必须处理这个问题。

defsEn: n. the quality of being worthy of esteem or respect
n. formality in bearing and appearance
n. high office or rank or station
zh: n. 尊严, 高贵
examples: Your action has offended his dignity.
They approach the world with dignity and grace.
exampleZh: 你的行为已经冒犯了他的尊严。

defsEn: r. in a tight or constricted manner
r. securely fixed or fastened
zh: adv. 紧紧地, 坚固地
examples: She held on to my hand tightly.
I hugged him tightly and cried.
exampleZh: 她紧紧抓住了我的手。
我紧紧地抱着他哭。

defsEn: n. state of uncertainty or perplexity especially as requiring a choice between equally unfavorable options
zh: n. 困境, (进退两难的)窘境
examples: A moral dilemma can be difficult to solve.
I am in a terrible dilemma.

defsEn: n. the state of being legally obliged and responsible
n. the quality of being something that holds you back
zh: n. 责任, 债务, 倾向
examples: Our company is a limited-liability company.
The company did not admit liability.
exampleZh: 我们公司是有限公司。

defsEn: r. in an exhaustive manner
r. completely and absolutely (`good' is sometimes used informally for `thoroughly')
zh: adv. 彻底地, 绝对地, 透彻地, 详尽地, 周到地, 完全地, 完善地, 全面地
examples: They got thoroughly wet in the rain.
Investigate thoroughly the bushes where the enemy may be hiding.
exampleZh: 他们在雨中被淋得全身都湿了。
仔细搜寻敌人可能藏身的灌木丛。

defsEn: n. small slender-bodied chiefly marine decapod crustaceans with a long tail and single pair of pincers
many species are edible
v. fish for shrimp
zh: n. 虾, 小虾, 矮子
vi. 捕小虾
examples: Put another shrimp on the barbecue.
I find the shrimp salad delicious.

defsEn: n. the attire worn in a play or at a fancy dress ball
n. unusual or period attire not characteristic of or appropriate to the time and place
n. the prevalent fashion of dress (including accessories and hair style as well as garments)
n. the attire characteristic of a country or a time or a social class
zh: n. 装束, 服装
examples: What do you think of my costume?
I need to change into my costume.

defsEn: v. to draw back the lips and reveal the teeth, in a smile, grimace, or snarl
zh: n. 露齿笑
v. 露齿而笑
examples: We just have to grin and bear it.
I looked at Tom and grinned.
exampleZh: 我们只能强忍着。
我看着汤姆，然后笑了。

defsEn: n. a humorous or satirical drawing published in a newspaper or magazine
n. a film made by photographing a series of cartoon drawings to give the illusion of movement when projected in rapid sequence
v. draw cartoons of
zh: n. 卡通画, 漫画
v. 画漫画
examples: The Jetsons, a cartoon about family life in the future, influenced my childhood.
She watched the cartoon with me.

defsEn: n. (economics) the ratio of the quantity and quality of units produced to the labor per unit of time
zh: n. 生产力
examples: Productivity will increase with the expansion of the factory.
How do you boost your productivity at work?

defsEn: n. general term for any insect or similar creeping or crawling invertebrate
n. a fault or defect in a computer program, system, or machine
n. a small hidden microphone
for listening secretly
zh: n. 错误, 虫, 病菌, 缺陷, 窃听器, 癖好, 防盗报警器, 双座小汽车, 要人
vt. 装防盗报警器, 装窃听器, 激怒
vi. 捉虫, 暴突
examples: All bugs should be fixed today before we leave.
It's not a bug. It's an undocumented feature.
exampleZh: 所有bug应该在今天下班前解决。
这不是一个漏洞，而是一个没有写进文档的特性。

defsEn: n. a state of complete lack of some abstract property
n. inability to discharge all your debts as they come due
n. a legal process intended to insure equality among the creditors of a corporation declared to be insolvent
zh: n. 破产者
examples: If I declare bankruptcy, will I be able to keep my house?
She almost took him to the edge of bankruptcy.

defsEn: n. anything that tends to arouse
n. an additional payment (or other remuneration) to employees as a means of increasing output
zh: n. 奖金, 红利
examples: That would give him an attack bonus of two.
I have a bonus tip for you.

defsEn: n. act of working jointly
n. act of cooperating traitorously with an enemy that is occupying your country
zh: n. 合作, 勾结
examples: Your collaboration is important for all of us.
Communication is the key to collaboration.

defsEn: n. a detachment used for security or reconnaissance
n. the activity of going around or through an area at regular intervals for security purposes
n. a group that goes through a region at regular intervals for the purpose of security
v. maintain the security of by carrying out a patrol
zh: n. 巡逻, 巡逻员, 侦察队
v. 巡逻, 巡视
examples: He did the patrol at two in the morning.
We saw a patrol car running at full speed.

defsEn: n. an enlightening or astonishing disclosure
n. communication of knowledge to man by a divine or supernatural agency
n. the last book of the New Testament
contains visionary descriptions of heaven and of conflicts between good and evil and of the end of the world
attributed to Saint John the Apostle
zh: n. 揭露, 泄露, 发觉, 默示, 启示
examples: Poetry is an exploration, a revelation, and an invitation for dialogue.
It's not a particularly brilliant revelation of mine.

defsEn: v. draw slowly or heavily
v. transport in a vehicle
zh: n. 用力拖拉, 拖运, 强拉, 捕获量, 拖运距离
vi. 拖, 拉, 改变方向, 改变主意
vt. 拖拉, 拖运
examples: We're in this for the long haul.
We're in it for the long haul.

defsEn: v. admit (to a wrongdoing)
v. be willing to concede
v. give over
surrender or relinquish to the physical control of another
v. acknowledge defeat
zh: vt. 承认, 退让
vi. 让步
examples: I concede the point, but not the argument.
The accountant would not concede the mistake.

defsEn: n. a lavishly produced performance
s. characteristic of spectacles or drama
zh: a. 公开展示的, 惊人的, 壮观的
n. 奇观, 惊人之举, 展览物
examples: I want to show you a spectacular view.
He caught the ball with a spectacular dive.

defsEn: v. cause to sheer
r. straight up or down without a break
r. directly
zh: a. 绝对的, 全然的, 纯粹的, 透明的, 峻峭的
vi. 偏转, 偏航
vt. 使急转向, 使偏航
adv. 完全, 全然, 峻峭
n. 偏航
examples: It is a sheer waste of time.
She put two pairs of sheer tights in the suitcase.
exampleZh: 这完全是浪费时间。
她在行李箱中放进了两条裤袜。

defsEn: n. a person who is immune to a particular infection
a. relating to the condition of immunity
s. secure against
s. relating to or conferring immunity (to disease or infection)
zh: a. 免疫的, 免除的, 不受影响的
n. 免疫者
examples: Everybody is immune to smallpox nowadays.
No one should be immune to justice in Algeria.
exampleZh: 现今每个人都对天花免疫了。

defsEn: n. a pompous fool
n. hardy and sure-footed animal smaller and with longer ears than the horse
zh: n. 驴, 傻瓜, 笨蛋, 屁股
examples: It's such a pain in the ass.
I don't give a rat's ass.
exampleZh: 烦死人。
我完全不管。

defsEn: r side by side
zh: adv. 在旁边, 靠拢着
prep. 在...旁边, 与...在一起

zh: a. 货币的, 金钱的
examples: Monetary value is the dominant value in American society.
Monetary policy is always foreign policy, too.

defsEn: v. represent, as of a character on stage
v. represent or express something abstract in tangible form
zh: vt. 具体表达, 使具体化
examples: The laws of a land embody the spirit of its people.
He always envisioned a child who would embody his legacy.

defsEn: n. something that is a counterfeit
not what it seems to be
s. not genuine or real
being an imitation of the genuine article
it's real synthetic fur"
zh: n. 假货, 欺骗, 诡计
a. 假的
vt. 假造, 仿造
vi. 伪装
examples: The fake king plays golf while the real king consolidates his power.
Donald said goodbye to that fake life forever.
exampleZh: 真正的王在巩固他的权利，然而虚假的王却在打高尔夫。
唐纳德彻底告别了那种虚假的生活。

defsEn: n. decapod having eyes on short stalks and a broad flattened carapace with a small abdomen folded under the thorax and pincers
n. a quarrelsome grouch
n. the edible flesh of any of various crabs
n. a stroke of the oar that either misses the water or digs too deeply
zh: n. 螃蟹, 偏航, 脾气乖戾的人, 沙果
vi. 捕蟹, 偏航, 发牢骚
vt. 使偏航, 抱怨, 破坏
examples: The first person who ate crab must also have tried to eat a spider.
I regard crab as a great delicacy.
exampleZh: 第一个吃螃蟹的人一定也吃过蜘蛛。

defsEn: n. the form of a literary work submitted for publication
n. handwritten book or document
zh: n. 手稿, 原稿, 底稿
a. 手写的
examples: He showed me the manuscript of his new play.
The manuscript will be found inside a bottle.
exampleZh: 他给我看了他最新剧的底稿。

defsEn: n. concern with the distinction between good and evil or right and wrong
right or good conduct
zh: n. 道德, 教训, 品行
examples: Morality is mostly a matter of how much temptation you can withstand.
Today, morality should come from the higher power of the West.

defsEn: n. a conflict of people's opinions or actions or characters
n. the speech act of disagreeing or arguing or disputing
zh: n. 不合, 争论, 不一致
examples: They express disagreement by shaking their heads, which may indicate agreement in other countries.
Jim sometimes has disagreements with his wife.
exampleZh: 他们以摇头表示不同意，而其他国家的人可能以摇头表示同意。
吉姆有时与他的妻子意见分歧。

defsEn: n. any of various Chinese boats with a high poop and lugsails
zh: n. 垃圾, 乌七八糟的东西, 舢板
examples: Tom has accumulated a lot of junk.
Can you get this junk out of here?
exampleZh: 汤姆屯了很多垃圾。

defsEn: v. make senseless or dizzy by or as if by a blow
v. overcome as with astonishment or disbelief
zh: vt. 使昏迷, 使震惊, 打昏
n. 昏迷, 猛击
examples: Everyone in the room was stunned by what happened.
Everybody in the room was stunned by what happened.
exampleZh: 屋里人都被发生的事惊住了。
屋里人都被发生的事惊住了。

defsEn: n. a tense critical situation
n. a number of birds hatched at the same time
n. a pedal or lever that engages or disengages a rotating shaft and a driving mechanism
n. a coupling that connects or disconnects driving and driven parts of a driving mechanism
zh: n. 抓紧, 掌握, 离合器, 一窝小鸡
vt. 抓住, 踩汽车离合器踏板
vi. 抓
examples: Take your foot off the clutch.
He slowly let the clutch out and drove off.

defsEn: n. a mental or physical breakdown
n. a cessation of normal operation
n. an analysis into mutually exclusive categories
zh: n. 崩溃, 故障
examples: She had a nervous breakdown because of too much work.
I had a nervous breakdown because of work stress.

defsEn: n. either of two bean-shaped excretory organs that filter wastes (especially urea) from the blood and excrete them and water in urine
zh: n. 肾, 个性
examples: Would you be willing to donate a kidney?
If he donates a kidney, he can survive with the other one.

defsEn: n. the ability to read and write
zh: n. 读写能力, 识字, 精通文学
examples: Secondly, the literacy rate in Europe of that time was low.
News literacy is the ability to use critical thinking skills to judge news reports.

defsEn: n. an event (or a course of events) that will inevitably happen in the future
n. the ultimate agency regarded as predetermining the course of events (often personified as a woman)
zh: n. 命运, 定数
examples: You are the master of your own destiny.
You're the master of your own destiny.
exampleZh: 你才是自己命运的主人。
你才是自己命运的主人。

defsEn: n. any activity that is performed alone without assistance
n. a musical composition for one voice or instrument (with or without accompaniment)
n. a flight in which the aircraft pilot is unaccompanied
v. fly alone, without a co-pilot or passengers
zh: n. 独奏, 独唱, 单独表演
a. 单独的, 独奏的, 独唱的
vi. 放单飞
examples: I hope you practiced your flute solo!
Better to go solo than to be in bad company.
exampleZh: 我希望你练习了你的长笛独奏！

defsEn: n. an inquiry into unfamiliar or questionable activities
n. a flexible slender surgical instrument with a blunt end that is used to explore wounds or body cavities
n. an exploratory action or expedition
n. an investigation conducted using a flexible surgical instrument to explore an injury or a body cavity
zh: n. 探索, 调查, 探针, 探测器
v. 用探针探测, 调查, 探索
examples: I dare not probe too deeply, lest I uncover the awful truth!
Probe into the cause of the accident.
exampleZh: 我不敢探查得太深, 以免发现可怕的事实。

defsEn: r. extremely
r. so as to be positive
in a positive manner
zh: adv. 明确地, 肯定地, 无疑地, (非正式)确实地, 真正地
examples: I want to contribute positively to my community.
I look positively on working with them.

defsEn: n a light informal meal
v eat a snack
eat lightly
zh: n. 小吃, 点心, 快餐
vi. 吃零食, 吃快餐
examples: There were many delicious snacks at the party.
The mooncake is a kind of Chinese snack.
exampleZh: 派对上有很多美味的小吃。
月饼是中国点心的一种。

defsEn: n. traveler who moves from one region or country to another
s. habitually moving from place to place especially in search of seasonal work
zh: n. 候鸟, 移居者
examples: The migrant finally found his home.
The migrant finally found her home.

defsEn: n. the quality of being adequately or well qualified physically and intellectually
zh: n. 胜任, 职称, 能力
examples: Develop your linguistic competence as much as possible.
No one doubts his competence for this position.

defsEn: n. a deposit of personal property as security for a debt
n. someone accepted for membership but not yet fully admitted to the group
n. a drink in honor of or to the health of a person or event
v. promise solemnly and formally
zh: n. 诺言, 保证, 誓言, 抵押, 信物, 保人, 祝愿
vt. 许诺, 保证, 使发誓, 抵押, 典当, 举杯祝...健康
examples: I pledge allegiance to the flag.
We pledge to do our share.
exampleZh: 我向国旗宣誓效忠。

defsEn: n. a close observer
someone who looks at something (such as an exhibition of some kind)
zh: n. 观众, 目击者, 旁观者
examples: There weren't many spectators at the game because of the rain.
What's the most popular spectator sport in your country?
exampleZh: 因为下雨了，球场上没有很多观众。

defsEn: n. the activity of protecting something from loss or danger
n. the condition of being (well or ill) preserved
n. a process that saves organic substances from decay
zh: n. 保存, 保藏, 保护
examples: He has dedicated his life to the preservation of nature.
My sense of self preservation keeps me from jumping out of perfectly good airplanes.

defsEn: v. assign a name or title to
s. appointed but not yet installed in office
zh: vt. 指定, 指明, 称呼
a. 已选出而未上任的
examples: She designated their table with a wave of the hand.
Always have a designated spot for the towels to hang and dry.

defsEn: n. one who precedes you in time (as in holding a position or office)
zh: n. 前任, 先辈, 前身
examples: Floppy disks are the predecessor of hard disks.
I intend to follow my predecessor's policy.
exampleZh: 软盘是硬盘的前身。

defsEn: n. either of two or more related or complementary variables
v. to bear a reciprocal or mutual relation
v. bring into a mutual, complementary, or reciprocal relation
zh: n. 有相互关系的东西, 相关物
vt. 使有相互关系
vi. 相关
examples: I used to correlate love with sex.

defsEn: s. never-ceasing
a. retained
not shed
zh: a. 固执的, 坚持的, 持续的, 作用持久的
examples: Be patient and persistent. These things take time.
I have a persistent pain here.
exampleZh: 耐心地坚持下去，这些事急不来。

defsEn: n. someone devoted to the promotion of human welfare and to social reforms
a. of or relating to or characteristic of humanitarianism
zh: n. 人道主义者, 博爱者, 基督凡人论者
a. 人道主义的, 博爱的, 凡人论的
examples: The phrase "humanitarian bombing" is an oxymoron.
Can the humanitarian team do more?
exampleZh: 「人道主义轰炸」一词是自相矛盾的。

defsEn: n. any utterance produced simultaneously by a group
n. a group of people assembled to sing together
n. a body of dancers or singers who perform together
n. a company of actors who comment (by speaking or singing in unison) on the action in a classical Greek play
zh: n. 合唱队, 齐声
v. 齐声说道, 合唱
examples: We sang in chorus to the piano.
The party ended up with a chorus.

defsEn: v. be brought back to life, consciousness, or strength
v. restore from a depressed, inactive, or unused state
zh: vt. 使苏醒, 使复兴, 使振奋, 回想起, 重播
vi. 苏醒, 复活, 复兴, 恢复精神
examples: A spring rain revived the flower.
The article on Buddhism revived my interest in oriental religions.
exampleZh: 一场春雨使花朵回复了生气。
那篇关于佛教的文章再次勾起了我对东方宗教的兴趣。

defsEn: n. the trait of being cautious
being attentive to possible danger
n. a warning against certain acts
n. judiciousness in avoiding harm or danger
v. warn strongly
put on guard
zh: n. 小心, 慎重, 警示
vt. 警告
examples: Caution: risk of electric shock. Do not open.
I repeat it by way of caution.

defsEn: v. start abruptly
v. erupt or intensify suddenly
v. start to burn or burst into flames
v. break out
zh: vi. 爆发
vt. 喷出
examples: An argument erupted between her and her father.
The active volcano erupts at regular intervals.
exampleZh: 她和她父亲的争吵爆发了。
活火山会定期爆发。

defsEn: n a celebrity who is an inspiration to others
s worthy of notice
s widely known and esteemed
zh: n. 著名人士, 值得注意之事物
a. 值得注意的, 显著的
examples: With a few notable exceptions, the language of opera is Italian.
Our century has seen a notable increase of knowledge.

defsEn: n. a stick that people can lean on to help them walk
n. a strong slender often flexible stem as of bamboos, reeds, rattans, or sugar cane
n. a stiff switch used to hit students as punishment
v. beat with a cane
zh: n. 手杖, 细长的茎, 藤条
vt. 以杖击, 以藤编制
examples: I used to walk with a cane.
A candy cane can easily be made into a weapon.

defsEn: n. a gentle blow
n. voluble conversation
n. genre of African-American music of the 1980s and 1990s in which rhyming lyrics are chanted to a musical accompaniment
several forms of rap have emerged
v. strike sharply
zh: n. 轻敲, 拍击, 责骂, 无价值的东西
vt. 轻敲, 厉声说出, 叱责, 抢走, 使着迷
vi. 敲击, 发敲击声, 交谈, 同情
examples: He has a rap sheet the length of the Bible.
Why should I take the rap for Tom?

defsEn: n. furnace consisting of a special hearth where metal is heated before shaping
n. a workplace where metal is worked by heating and hammering
v. create by hammering
v. make a copy of with the intent to deceive
zh: n. 熔炉, 铁工厂
vt. 打制, 锻造, 伪造
vi. 锻造, 伪造
examples: Only I can forge my own fate.
He forged a signature in an attempt to put blame on the other person.

defsEn: v. throw into disorder
zh: a. 分裂的, 中断的
vt. 使分裂, 使瓦解
examples: I believe it would disrupt the balance.
The accident at the junction disrupted the flow of traffic.

defsEn: n any property detected by the olfactory system
n the sensation that results when olfactory receptors in the nose are stimulated by particular chemicals in gaseous form
zh: n. 气味, 香味, 名声, 意味
examples: A strong odor can be a sign of an issue.
We can smell an odor of tobacco in this bedroom.

defsEn: v take off weight
s being of delicate or slender build
s small in quantity
zh: a. 瘦的, 苗条的, 微小的, 稀少的, 微薄的
vi. 变苗条
vt. 使苗条
examples: She has blonde hair and a slim figure.
If you want to be slim, follow this diet.
exampleZh: 她有着一头金发，瘦高的身材。

defsEn: v. report or maintain
zh: vt. 宣称, 主张, 提出, 断言
examples: The boss is alleged to have hit a worker.
The newspaper alleged his involvement in the crime.

defsEn: a. of or pertaining to or characteristic of Judaism
a. adhering to what is commonly accepted
a. of or relating to or characteristic of the Eastern Orthodox Church
zh: a. 正统的, 传统的, 惯常的
examples: This year, the Orthodox and the Catholic Easter coincide.
This year, the Orthodox Easter coincides with the Catholic one.

defsEn: n. a sudden violent spontaneous occurrence (usually of some undesirable condition)
zh: n. 爆发, 暴动
examples: There will be outbreaks of rain overnight.
The public took the outbreak seriously.

defsEn: s. not to be placated or appeased or moved by entreaty
zh: a. 冷酷的, 坚强的, 残忍的, 可怕的, 讨厌的
examples: That evening tea was partaken of in a grim silence.
Marcia looked grim when I told her the story.

defsEn: n. a small ball with a hole through the middle
v. form into beads, as of water or sweat, for example
v. decorate by sewing beads onto
v. string together like beads
zh: n. 珠子, 滴
vt. 用珠装饰
vi. 形成珠
examples: I need a yellow bead to make the center of the daisy.
The bead rolled into the slot.

defsEn: v. stand up for
stick up for
of causes, principles, or ideals
v. support against an opponent
zh: vt. 支撑, 赞成, 鼓励, 举起, 坚持
examples: The referee must uphold the rules of the game.
We must uphold the law at all times.

defsEn: s. involving risk or danger
zh: a. 危险的, 冒险的, 碰运气的
examples: The road was too hazardous to travel in the snow.
Lead is hazardous to human health.

defsEn: n. additional proof that something that was believed (some fact or hypothesis or theory) is correct
n. information that confirms or verifies
n. a ceremony held in the synagogue (usually at Pentecost) to admit as adult members of the Jewish community young men and women who have successfully completed a course of study in Judaism
zh: n. 证实, 证明, 批准, 确认
examples: Here we see confirmation of an old truth: war is never useful.
Up to then there had been no official announcement or confirmation.

defsEn: v become one
v mix together different elements
v join or combine
zh: vt. 使合并, 使消失, 吞没
vi. 合并, 渐渐消失
examples: The Mitsubishi Bank merged with the Bank of Tokyo.
These two municipalities will merge from next year.
exampleZh: 三菱银行和东京银行合并了。

defsEn: n. a line that forms the length of an arrow pointer
n. a long rod or pole (especially the handle of an implement or the body of a weapon like a spear or arrow)
n. a vertical passageway through a building (as for an elevator)
n. (architecture) upright consisting of the vertical part of a column
zh: n. 轴, 箭杆, 矛, 矿井
vt. 装杆于, 利用
examples: The elevator shaft goes all the way to the basement.
The elevator shaft reaches down to the basement.

defsEn: n the act of taking something from someone unlawfully
zh: n. 盗窃, 失窃, 盗窃罪, 赃物
examples: The police accused him of theft.
You can't accuse him of theft without having proof.
exampleZh: 警察起诉他盗窃。
没有证据你们不能指责他偷东西。

defsEn: n. a courteous or respectful or considerate act
n. a courteous or respectful or considerate remark
n. a courteous manner
zh: n. 礼貌, 谦恭, 好意
examples: I thank you for your courtesy.
The team paid a courtesy visit to the local community center.

defsEn: n. the dissemination of copies of periodicals (as newspapers or magazines)
n. movement through a circuit
especially the movement of blood through the heart and blood vessels
n. (library science) the count of books that are loaned by a library over a specified period
n. number of copies of a newspaper or magazine that are sold
zh: n. 流通, 循环, 发行量
examples: The circulation of the newspaper is only one-third that of its competitor.
What is the circulation of this magazine?

defsEn: v. add embellishments and paintings to (medieval manuscripts)
zh: vt. 照明, 用灯装饰, 阐明, 说明, 使灿烂
vi. 照亮, 用灯装饰
examples: Thousands of candles illuminated the church during the ceremony.
The square was illuminated by bright lights.
exampleZh: 数以千计的蜡烛点亮了仪式中的教堂。
广场被鲜明的灯火照亮。

defsEn: a. of or relating to or produced by evolution
zh: a. 展开的, 进化论的, 进化的, 发展的
examples: The popular conception of evolutionary psychology is even less scientific than the discipline itself.
Evolutionary psychologists mostly focus on what makes us so much alike.

defsEn: n. defect or weakness in a person's character
n. an imperfection in a plan or theory or legal document that causes it to fail or that reduces its effectiveness
v. add a flaw or blemish to
make imperfect or defective
zh: n. 缺点, 裂纹, 瑕疵, 一阵狂风
examples: Although she has flaws, I still like her.
I embrace my flaws as part of my story.
exampleZh: 虽然她有缺点，但我喜欢她。

defsEn: n. the optimistic feeling that all is going to turn out well
n. a general disposition to expect the best in all things
zh: n. 乐观主义, 乐观, 乐天
examples: I look to the future with optimism.
There is considerable optimism that the economy will improve.

defsEn: v. cause to feel sure
give reassurance to
v. give or restore confidence in
cause to feel sure or certain
zh: vt. 使...安心, 向...再保证
examples: Reassure your children that you love them.
I reassured him that I would not be late.

defsEn: n. the head of the Roman Catholic Church
n. English poet and satirist (1688-1744)
zh: n. 罗马教皇, 主教
examples: The Pope has no right to marry.
I don't care that you're the Pope; you can't touch my feet.
exampleZh: 罗马教皇无权结婚。
我才不管您是不是个什么教皇，我的脚您别碰。

defsEn: a. of or concerned with or related to the future
zh: a. 预期的, 将来的
examples: We have several prospective new members. I hope they will join us.
The company invited their prospective customers to the party.

defsEn: n. the property of a more than adequate quantity or supply
n. (physics) the ratio of the number of atoms of a specific isotope of an element to the total number of isotopes present
n. (chemistry) the ratio of the total mass of an element in the earth's crust to the total mass of the earth's crust
expressed as a percentage or in parts per million
zh: n. 丰富, 充足, 大量
examples: Abundance of love can help to save this world.
We have an abundance of plant life here.

defsEn: n. (logic) a statement that affirms or denies something and is either true or false
n. an offer for a private bargain (especially a request for sexual favors)
n. a task to be dealt with
v. suggest sex to
zh: n. 建议, 命题, 主张
vt. 向...提议, 向...提出猥亵的要求
examples: An interesting proposition is raised in your book.
I have a business proposition for you.
exampleZh: 你书中提出了个有意思的命题。

defsEn: n. someone who waits on or tends to or attends to the needs of another
n. a person who is present and participates in a meeting
s. being present (at meeting or event etc.) "attendant members of the congreation"
s. following or accompanying as a consequence
zh: n. 随从, 侍者, 出席者
a. 侍候的, 伴随的, 出席的, 在场的
examples: I work as a museum attendant.
The flight attendant gave each passenger a drink and a snack.

defsEn: v put in effect
v meet the requirements or expectations of
v fill or meet a want or need
zh: vt. 实践, 履行, 实行, 完成, 结束, 满足
examples: Give her a chance to fulfill her desire.
You must fulfill your promise without fail.

defsEn: n. a piece of poetry
n. a line of metrical text
v. compose verses or put into verse
v. familiarize through thorough study or experience
zh: n. 诗, 韵文, 诗句
vt. 用诗表达
vi. 作诗
examples: He translated the verse into English.
How do you interpret this verse?
exampleZh: 他把诗翻译成英语。

defsEn: n. a rapid series of short loud sounds (as might be heard with a stethoscope in some types of respiratory disorders)
n. a baby's toy that makes percussive noises when shaken
n. loosely connected horny sections at the end of a rattlesnake's tail
v. make short successive sounds
zh: vt. 使嘎嘎响, 喋喋不休地说
vi. 格格响, 喋喋不休
n. 格格声, 拨浪鼓, 喋喋不休的话
examples: The baby had a rattle in his hand.
She heard the rattle of the snake.

defsEn: v. break into many pieces
v. damage or destroy
v. cause to break into many pieces
zh: n. 碎片, 粉碎, 落叶, 喷洒
vt. 打碎, 使散开, 粉碎, 破坏
vi. 粉碎, 损坏, 脱落
examples: The vase crashed and shattered into pieces.
As soon as he hit him, he shattered his head.
exampleZh: 花瓶摔成碎片了。

defsEn: n. a movement downward
n. the act of changing your location in a downward direction
n. the kinship relation between an individual and the individual's progenitors
n. a downward slope or bend
zh: n. 降落, 家系, 侵袭, 血统
examples: I met them during my descent from the peak.
This word is of Latin descent.

defsEn: s. dazzlingly beautiful
zh: a. 华丽的, 灿烂的
examples: She is wearing gorgeous silk clothes.
We live in a gorgeous place.
exampleZh: 她穿着华丽的丝绸服饰。

defsEn: n. someone given to teasing (as by mocking or stirring curiosity)
n. the act of harassing someone playfully or maliciously (especially by ridicule)
provoking someone with persistent annoyances
v. annoy persistently
v. harass with persistent criticism or carping
zh: n. 揶揄, 戏弄, 逗惹
vt. 戏弄, 取笑, 强求, 梳理, 使起毛
examples: I always tease people I love.
My mom used to tease me all the time about it.

defsEn: n. a solemn pledge (to oneself or to another or to a deity) to do something or to behave in a certain manner
v. make a vow
promise
v. dedicate to a deity by a vow
zh: n. 誓约, 誓言, 许愿
vi. 起誓, 发誓, 郑重宣言
vt. 立誓, 起誓要, 郑重地宣布
examples: I vowed that I would never speak to her again.
He vowed to give up smoking.
exampleZh: 我发誓再也不跟她说话了。

defsEn: n the properties acquired as a consequence of the way you were treated as a child

north temperate zone

exampleZh: 能把枫糖浆递给我吗？
我们早餐吃了煎饼和枫糖浆。

There is not a scrap of truth in his words.

I'll take your suitcase to your room.

zh: n. 码头, 桥墩, 支框, 防波堤
examples: Tie up your boat to the pier.
There used to be a pier here.

defsEn: n. a hard malleable ductile silvery metallic element that is resistant to corrosion
used in alloys
occurs in pentlandite and smaltite and garnierite and millerite
n. a United States coin worth one twentieth of a dollar
n. five dollars worth of a drug
v. plate with nickel
zh: n. 镍, 镍币, 五分镍币
vt. 镀镍于
examples: I just found a nickel in the street.
I found a nickel in between the couch cushions.

defsEn: r. in an ideal manner
zh: adv. 完美地, 理想地
examples: Ideally, a candidate for this job should have four years' work experience.
Ideally, I would stay here forever, but unfortunately that is not possible.
exampleZh: 我们希望应聘者能有4年工作经验。

defsEn: n. the act of assuming or maintaining a crouching position with the knees bent and the buttocks near the heels
v. sit on one's heels
v. be close to the earth, or be disproportionately wide
v. occupy (a dwelling) illegally
zh: n. 蹲, 窝
a. 蹲着的, 矮胖的
vi. 蹲下, 蹲坐, 蹲伏
vt. 使蹲下, 擅自占有
examples: You need to work on your squat form.
He squatted down next to his dog.

defsEn: n. a crafty and involved plot to achieve your (usually sinister) ends
n. a clandestine love affair
v. cause to be interested or curious
zh: n. 阴谋, 复杂的事
vi. 密谋, 私通
vt. 激起...的兴趣, 用诡计取得
examples: Your way of thinking intrigues me.
I'm intrigued to know what you think it means.

defsEn: n. the spatial property possessed by an arrangement or position of things in a straight line or in parallel lines
n. the act of adjusting or aligning the parts of a device in relation to each other
zh: n. 队列, 结盟, 校正
examples: My side mirror is out of alignment.
What effects would planetary alignment have?

defsEn: n. closing one eye quickly as a signal
v. signal by winking
v. force to go away by blinking
zh: n. 眨眼, 使眼色, 瞬间
vi. 眨眼, 使眼色, 闪烁
vt. 眨
examples: I didn't sleep a wink last night.
In a wink, Gunter was gone.
exampleZh: 我昨晚没睡。
眨个眼的功夫，贡特就不见了。

defsEn: n. (chemistry) a substance that initiates or accelerates a chemical reaction without itself being affected
n. something that causes an important event to happen
zh: n. 触媒, 接触剂, 催化剂, 刺激因素, 促进因素
examples: The catalyst system efficiency is below the threshold.
Catalysts can speed up a chemical reaction without being consumed in the catalyzed reaction.

defsEn: n. a tall piece of furniture that provides storage space for clothes
has a door and rails or hooks for hanging clothes
n. collection of clothing belonging to one person
n. collection of costumes belonging to a theatrical company
zh: n. 衣橱, 衣室, 全部衣服
examples: You need to plan your wardrobe for the trip.
We put them on top of the wardrobe.

defsEn: n. a thick fatty oil (especially one used to lubricate machinery)
v. lubricate with grease
zh: n. 脂肪, 兽脂, 油脂, 贿赂
vt. 涂脂于, 贿赂
examples: Without sufficient grease the machine will seize up easily.
I need more grease in my diet.

defsEn: s. (used of persons or artifacts) marked by independence and creativity in thought or action
zh: a. 想像的, 虚构的
examples: He used to be an imaginative boy.
He is a very imaginative writer.
exampleZh: 他曾经是一个富有想像力的男孩。
他是非常有想像力的作家。

defsEn: s. inspiring mixed contempt and pity
s. inspiring scornful pity
zh: a. 悲哀的, 可怜的, 感伤的, 差劲的
examples: You look pathetic in that outfit.
That seems to me a rather pathetic aspiration.

defsEn: n. an excited state of a stable particle causing a sharp maximum in the probability of absorption of electromagnetic radiation
n. a vibration of large amplitude produced by a relatively small vibration near the same frequency of vibration as the natural frequency of the resonating system
n. the quality imparted to voiced speech sounds by the action of the resonating chambers of the throat and mouth and nasal cavities
zh: n. 共鸣, 回声, 反响, 谐振, 共振
examples: The story achieved a wide resonance.
By using four types of metal, specific frequency resonance is suppressed.

defsEn: s. vibrating slightly and irregularly
as e.g. with fear or cold or like the leaves of an aspen in a breeze
zh: a. 震动的, 摇晃的, 动摇的
examples: This table is shaky. Make it stay firm.
He answered with a shaky voice.

defsEn: n. the trait of being willing to give your money or time
n. acting generously
zh: n. 慷慨, 宽大
examples: We thank you for your generosity.
Your generosity of heart is worth more than any fortune.

defsEn: v. move as if through a sieve
v. separate by passing through a sieve or other straining device to separate out coarser elements
zh: vt. 筛, 过滤, 撒, 详查
vi. 筛, 被筛下, 精选
examples: Sift the flour to remove the lumps.
She forgot to sift the flour.

defsEn: n. originality by virtue of being new and surprising
zh: n. 新奇, 新鲜, 新奇的事物
examples: The novelty will wear off in time.
The novelty wears off in time.

defsEn: n. the location of a visual perception along a continuum from black to white
n. intelligence as manifested in being quick and witty
zh: n. 光亮, 明亮, 聪明
examples: Can you lower the brightness on this monitor?
Did you adjust the brightness on your TV?

defsEn: v pay back
v make repayment for or return something
v act or give recompense in recognition of someone's behavior or actions
v answer back
zh: v. 偿还, 报答, 报复
examples: Repay your sins with your life.
I would like to repay him for his kindness.
exampleZh: 纳命来赎罪。

defsEn: v pose a threat to
present a danger to
v put at risk
zh: vt. 危害, 使受危困, 使陷危地
examples: Will this stuff jeopardize my health?
If you ignore the past, you jeopardize the future.
exampleZh: 这些东西对健康有害吗？

defsEn: v. offer to buy, as of stocks and shares
v. adopt as a belief
v. receive or obtain regularly
zh: vt. 捐献, 签署
vi. 赞成, 同意, 捐款, 预订, 认购
examples: What newspaper do you subscribe to?
Do you subscribe to any magazines?
exampleZh: 你订阅了什么报纸?
你有订阅任何杂志吗？

defsEn: a. of or relating to the spine or spinal cord
zh: a. 针的, 尖刺的, 尖刺状突起的, 脊骨的
examples: The brain and spinal cord give the orders.
Invertebrates have no backbone or spinal column.

defsEn: v. become more extreme
v. make more extreme
raise in quantity, degree, or intensity
v. increase the height of
zh: vt. 增高, 提高, 加强
vi. 升高, 变大
examples: It heightens our joy and our sorrow.
I have a heightened sensitivity to bad odors.

defsEn: n. the angular distance between an imaginary line around a heavenly body parallel to its equator and the equator itself
n. freedom from normal restraints in conduct
n. an imaginary line around the Earth parallel to the equator
n. scope for freedom of e.g. action or thought
freedom from restriction
zh: n. 纬度, 范围
examples: Algeria is at the same latitude as Washington DC.
The horse latitudes are subtropical regions known for calm winds and little precipitation.

defsEn: v. have affection for
feel tenderness for
zh: vi. 渴望, 想念, 怀念, 同情
examples: I feel a yearning for the university.
You yearn to become an adult at this age.
exampleZh: 我对于上大学有一种渴望。

defsEn: n. the study and classification of human societies
zh: n. 社会学
examples: Frank majored in sociology at university.
The student is working at sociology.
exampleZh: 弗兰克在大学主修社会学。
那个学生正在学习社会学。

defsEn: n. a tract of land with few or no trees in the middle of a wooded area
n. the act of freeing from suspicion
n. the act of removing solid particles from a liquid
zh: n. 清扫, 空地, 票据清算
examples: Remote forest clearings turn out to be great places for raves.
Small clearings mark where villages once stood.

defsEn: n. a plane curve traced by a point circling about the center but at increasing distances from the center
n. a continuously accelerating change in the economy
n. ornament consisting of a curve on a plane that winds around a center with an increasing distance from the center
n. flying downward in a helical path with a large radius
zh: n. 螺旋形之物, 螺线
a. 螺旋形的, 盘旋的
vi. 螺旋形下降, 螺旋形上升, 螺旋形行进
vt. 使螺旋形行进
examples: A snail's shell is spiral in form.
A spiral staircase leads onto the gallery of the church.
exampleZh: 蜗牛壳是螺旋形的.

defsEn: r. clear to the mind
with distinct mental discernment
r. in a distinct and distinguishable manner
r. to a distinct degree
zh: adv. 显然地, 明显地, 清楚地
examples: I distinctly remember hearing the clock on the mantelpiece strike two.
We could distinctly hear Kabyle music coming from the second floor.

defsEn: n. a nation's ruler or head of state usually by hereditary right
s. greatest in status or authority or power
zh: n. 元首, 独立国
a. 具有主权的, 至高无上的, 国王的, 完全的
examples: I hope for Taiwan to be a sovereign democratic country.
Zelenskyy is an elected president of a sovereign country.
exampleZh: 我希望台湾是主权独立的民主国家。
泽伦斯基是一位主权国家的民选总统。

defsEn: n. abnormally rapid beating of the auricles of the heart (especially in a regular rhythm)
can result in heart block
v. flap the wings rapidly or fly with flapping movements
zh: n. 摆动, 鼓翼, 烦扰
vi. 摆动, 鼓翼, 烦扰
vt. 拍(翅), 使焦急
examples: The butterfly fluttered from flower to flower.
The white curtains flutter in the breeze in a heavy, lazy motion, like waves.

defsEn: v. make oneself subject to
bring upon oneself
become liable to
zh: vt. 招致, 蒙受, 遭遇
examples: You do not want to incur the wrath of God.
Delaying study incurs the risk of great effort with little success.

defsEn: a. of or relating to the biological study of physiology
zh: a. 生理学的, 生理学上的, 生理机能的

defsEn: n something of sentimental value
n a reminder of past events
zh: n. 纪念品
examples: What souvenir do you think she would like most?
This will be a good souvenir of my trip around the United States.
exampleZh: 你觉得她最想要什么纪念品？
这将是我环绕美国旅行中一个很好的纪念品。

defsEn: v. make impossible, especially beforehand
zh: vt. 预先排除, 预防, 阻止, 妨碍
examples: That, of course, would effectively preclude the underlying tombs ever being investigated archaeologically.
Darkness from the storm and then nightfall precluded further battle that day.

defsEn: n. the offspring at one birth of a multiparous mammal
n. rubbish carelessly dropped or left about (especially in public places)
n. conveyance consisting of a chair or bed carried on two poles by bearers
v. strew
zh: n. 垃圾, 杂乱, 轿, 担架
vt. 乱丢, 铺草, 弄乱
vi. 产仔, 乱丢垃圾
examples: These children litter so much without conscience.
Remember to clean the litter box regularly for the kitten.

defsEn: s. intense or sharp
s. lavishly elegant and refined
s. of extreme beauty
zh: a. 精致的, 细腻的, 敏锐的
examples: The tourists were fascinated with the exquisite scenery.
Exquisite nature, daydreams, and music say one thing, real life another.
exampleZh: 观光客被独特的景致所吸引。

defsEn: v. thrust or throw into
v. enclose or envelop completely, as if by swallowing
zh: vt. 沉浸, 使陷入
examples: He is totally immersed in family life and has no wish to work.
You have to immerse yourself in the culture to learn the language.
exampleZh: 他完全沉浸于家庭生活中，不想工作了。

defsEn: n. a feeling of jealous envy (especially of a rival)
n. zealous vigilance
zh: n. 妒忌, 猜忌, 羡慕
examples: Her success made her the target of jealousy.
Love is blind, but jealousy can see even nonexistent things.
exampleZh: 她的成功让她受尽嫉妒。
爱是盲目的，但是嫉妒却可以看到即使并不存在的东西。

defsEn: n. any broad thin and limber covering attached at one edge
hangs loose or projects freely
n. the motion made by flapping up and down
n. a movable piece of tissue partly connected to the body
n. a movable airfoil that is part of an aircraft wing
used to increase lift or drag
zh: n. 飘, 摆动, 拍打, 拍打声, 片状垂悬物
v. 拍打, 鼓翼而飞, 飘动
examples: She flapped at the fly with a newspaper.
The flag flapped in the wind.

defsEn: s. forceful and extreme and rigorous
zh: a. 激烈的
examples: War caused a drastic decline in the male population.
The government undertook a drastic reform of parliament.

defsEn: n. intense mournfulness
zh: n. 悲哀, 悲痛, 苦痛
examples: Woe to you, your language and culture will be destroyed!
If I lose, woe unto me on that day!

defsEn: n. a small wave on the surface of a liquid
n. (electronics) an oscillation of small amplitude imposed on top of a steady value
v. stir up (water) so as to form ripples
v. flow in an irregular current with a bubbling noise
zh: n. 涟波, 涟漪, 波纹, 粗钢梳
vt. 使起涟漪
vi. 起微波, 起潺潺声
examples: A gentle wind made ripples on the surface of the pond.
The crisis had a ripple effect on the economy.
exampleZh: 微风在湖面上掀起了一丝丝涟漪。

defsEn: r. with moderation
in a moderate manner
zh: adv. 适当地, 适度地, 中庸地
examples: This is moderately spicy, but it does stimulate the appetite.
This is moderately spicy but stimulates the appetite.

defsEn: n. joint consisting of a line formed by joining two pieces
n. a stratum of ore or coal thick enough to be mined with profit
v. put together with a seam
zh: n. 缝合线, 衔接口, 接缝, 线缝, 伤疤
vt. 缝合, 接合, 焊合, 使留下伤痕
vi. 裂开, 发生裂痕
examples: Please take in the seams of the jacket a little.
I am walking up the seam of stairs.

defsEn: n. prolonged unfulfilled desire or need
zh: n. 渴望, 热望, 憧憬
a. 渴望的, 热望的
examples: Never before have we had such a strong longing for peace.
We are all longing for peace in the world.
exampleZh: 谁都希望世界和平。

defsEn: n alluring beauty or charm (often with sex-appeal)
v cast a spell over someone or something
put a hex on someone or something
zh: n. 魅力, 迷人的美, 魔法
vt. 迷惑
examples: Do you think I can handle all that glamour?
Being a movie star, she was used to a life of glitz and glamour.

defsEn: n. any of various mostly Mexican herbs of the genus Cosmos having radiate heads of variously colored flowers and pinnate leaves
popular fall-blooming annuals
zh: n. 宇宙, 秩序, 和谐, 大波斯菊
examples: Are we truly alone in the cosmos?
In the atom, in the cell, in the cosmos, Transcendent Intelligence is perceptible.

defsEn: a possessing or displaying courage
able to face and deal with danger or fear without flinching
zh: a. 勇敢的, 大胆的, 有胆量的
examples: Tom is very courageous, isn't he?
It is courageous of you to say such a thing.
exampleZh: 汤姆非常勇敢，不是么？

defsEn: v. be adjacent or come together
v. approach a limit as the number of terms increases without limit
v. move or draw together at a certain location
v. come together so as to form a single product
zh: vi. 聚合, 集中于一点
vt. 使集合
examples: Our interest converges on that point.
Why do physicists converge? Because they're monotonous and narrow.

defsEn: s. concerned with trivialities
zh: a. 琐碎的, 不重要的, 轻微的, 平常的
examples: Forget it, those are just trivial details.
A straight line is a trivial example of a curve.
exampleZh: 别想了，那不过是些无关紧要的细节。

defsEn: n. ceramic ware made of a more or less translucent ceramic
zh: n. 瓷器, 瓷
a. 瓷制的
examples: He wrote a book on porcelain.
Amanda looked like a porcelain doll in a dress.

defsEn: n. sound of rapid vibration
n. a confusion of activity and gossip
v. make a buzzing sound
v. fly low
zh: n. 嗡嗡声, 流言
vi. 发出嗡嗡声, 说闲话
vt. 使嗡嗡叫, 散布
examples: The buzzing of the bees makes me a little nervous.
I'm getting a bit of a nicotine buzz.
exampleZh: 蜜蜂的嗡嗡让我有一点紧张。
我有点醉烟。

defsEn: n. a device for lighting or igniting fuel or charges or fires
v. transport in a flatbottom boat
zh: n. 点火者, 点灯工人, 打火机, 驳船
vt. 以驳船搬运
examples: Sir, you have left your lighter on the table.
He likes green in a lighter shade.
exampleZh: 先生，您把您的打火机留在桌子上了。
他喜欢比较浅的绿色。

defsEn: n. an alphabetical list of names and addresses
n. (computer science) a listing of the files stored in memory (usually on a hard disk)
zh: n. 目录, 工商名录, 指南
examples: I'm not finding him in the telephone directory.
Our school's directory is quite old.

defsEn: n. an apparatus for burning fuel (or refuse)
n. the heating elements of a stove or range on which pots and pans are placed for cooking
zh: n. 火炉, 烧火的人
examples: Potassium, heated with a Bunsen burner, gives the flame a lilac color.
Remember to turn off the burner after you finish cooking.
exampleZh: 用本生灯加热钾，火焰就会呈现淡紫色。

defsEn: r. without question and beyond doubt
zh: adv. 决定了, 坚决, 明显, 显而易见, 显然, 明确, 果断, 毫无疑问
examples: That is decidedly short of satisfactory.
The atmosphere in the room was decidedly frosty.

defsEn: n. a device (generally used by carpenters) that holds things firmly together
v. fasten or fix with a clamp
v. impose or inflict forcefully
zh: n. 夹钳
vt. 夹紧, 强加
examples: The government clamped down on the minority group.
Tighten the clamp before you start sawing.

defsEn: v be a hindrance or obstacle to
v hinder or prevent the progress or accomplishment of
v put at a disadvantage
s located at or near the back of an animal
zh: a. 后面的
v. 阻碍, 打扰
examples: Nothing will hinder my malicious plan.
If alcohol hinders you from working, stop working.
exampleZh: 没有什么能阻碍我邪恶的计划。

defsEn: a. not suitable or right or appropriate
s. not conforming to legality, moral law, or social convention
s. not appropriate for a purpose or occasion
zh: a. 不合适的, 错误的, 不成体统的, 不道德的
examples: With improper use, he damaged the machine.
Improper transport and handling may cause structural and functional damage of the device.

defsEn: n. the hard woody stems of bamboo plants
used in construction and crafts and fishing poles
n. woody tropical grass having hollow woody stems
mature canes used for construction and furniture
zh: n. 竹子
examples: There's bamboo growing in the garden.
The bamboo shoot bent under the weight of the snow.
exampleZh: 花园里有竹子在生长。

defsEn: s. (of reputation) free from blemishes
zh: a. 无瑕疵的, 不锈的
examples: The stainless steel case gives the watch a sleek and durable finish.
The entire bathroom was stainless steel.

defsEn: n. the grooved surface of a pneumatic tire
n. the part (as of a wheel or shoe) that makes contact with the ground
n. structural member consisting of the horizontal part of a stair or step
v. tread or stomp heavily or roughly
zh: n. 踏, 步态, 梯级, 交尾, 鞋底
vi. 踏, 行走, 交尾
vt. 踩, 踏, 践踏, 跳(舞)
examples: Tread on a worm, and it will turn.
I may tread a land never before imprinted by the foot of man.

defsEn: n. the process of producing a chemical compound (usually by the union of simpler chemical compounds)
n. the combination of ideas into a complex whole
zh: n. 综合, 组织, 综合体
examples: With synthesis, you have to be objective.
The artist is a synthesis of the theoretical person and the practical one.

defsEn: n. an attitude of mind especially one that favors one alternative over others
n. (astronomy) the angle between the plane of the orbit and the plane of the ecliptic stated in degrees
n. (geometry) the angle formed by the x-axis and a given line (measured counterclockwise from the positive half of the x-axis)
n. that toward which you are inclined to feel a liking
zh: n. 倾向, 趋向, 倾斜度, 点头
examples: I have a natural inclination towards organization.
I have an inclination for poetry.

defsEn: a. including much or everything
and especially including stated limits
zh: a. 包含的, 包括的
examples: Do they foster an inclusive environment?
We strive to be more inclusive.

defsEn: n. gear (including necessary machinery) for a particular enterprise
n. formation of masts, spars, sails, etc., on a vessel
v. arrange the outcome of by means of deceit
v. manipulate in a fraudulent manner
zh: n. 装备, 帆装
vt. 装配, 装扮, 给船装帆, 垄断, 操纵
examples: There was another explosion on the rig.
Ziri was on top of the oil rig.

defsEn: a. of or relating to a vocation or occupation
especially providing or undergoing training in special skills
zh: a. 职业的
examples: Do you enjoy your vocational field?
The two met each other at a vocational college for animation.
exampleZh: 你喜欢你的职业吗？

defsEn: a. having or marked by bends or angles
not straight or aligned
a. not straight
dishonest or immoral or evasive
zh: a. 弯曲的, 歪的, 邪恶的
examples: The old lady had a crooked back.
Excuse me if my sentence is crooked.

defsEn: n. a payment for consecutive issues of a newspaper or magazine for a given period of time
n. agreement expressed by (or as if expressed by) signing your name
n. a pledged contribution
n. the act of signing your name
writing your signature (as on a document)
zh: n. 捐献, 订金, 订阅, 签署, 同意
examples: All subscriptions must be paid before the end of this year.
You asked us to extend the subscription.
exampleZh: 所有订购必须在今年年底前支付款项。

defsEn: n. a rough and bitter manner
n. the property of having a harsh unpleasant taste
zh: n. 苦味, 悲痛, 怨恨
examples: He couldn't stand the bitterness of the coffee.
There was a note of bitterness in his voice.
exampleZh: 他受不了咖啡的苦味。

defsEn: n. a long narrow furrow cut either by a natural process (such as erosion) or by a tool (as e.g. a groove in a phonograph record)
n. (anatomy) any furrow or channel on a bodily structure or part
v. make a groove in, or provide with a groove
zh: n. 凹槽, 惯例, 理想境况
vt. 开槽于
examples: I am not in the groove today.
We'll get back in the groove of things before long.

defsEn: n. the act of passing something along from one person or group to another
n. a crew of workers who relieve another crew
n. a fresh team to relieve weary draft animals
n. a race between teams
each member runs or swims part of the distance
zh: n. 驿马, 替班, 中继, 接力
vt. 分程传递, 转播, 使接替
vi. 接力传送, 转播
examples: I need you to relay some information for me.
The interpreter tried to relay as much information and detail as possible.

defsEn: v. grant a dispensation
grant an exemption
zh: vt. 分发, 分配
vi. 特许, 豁免
examples: I can dispense with her help.
