n a person who uses the mind creatively
zh: n. 智力, 出众的才华, 知识分子
examples: You have the intellect of a rock.
He is a man of intellect.

defsEn: r extremely
zh: adv. 极大地; 极端地; 极其; 非常
examples: Ending an affair is tremendously difficult.
It was tremendously exciting to be in Boston at that time.

defsEn: v. exaggerate or make bigger
v. fill with gas or air
v. cause prices to rise by increasing the available currency or credit
v. increase the amount or availability of, creating a rise in value
zh: vt. 使膨胀, 使得意, 使通货膨胀, 使充气
vi. 充气, 膨胀
examples: Do you know how to inflate the tire?
Have you ever inflated a balloon as big as this one?

defsEn: n. wood of any of various chestnut trees of the genus Castanea
n. any of several attractive deciduous trees yellow-brown in autumn
yield a hard wood and edible nuts in a prickly bur
n. edible nut of any of various chestnut trees of the genus Castanea
n. the brown color of chestnuts
zh: n. 栗子, 栗树, 栗色
a. 栗色的
examples: Chestnuts have to be boiled for at least fifteen minutes.
Mom, I want some chestnut rice. Can you make some?
exampleZh: 栗子至少要煮15分钟。

defsEn: s. resembling the wind in speed, force, or variability
zh: a. 多风的, 风强的, 腹胀的, 吹牛的
examples: I live in a rather windy area.
It's always windy near the sea.
exampleZh: 我居住的地方风比较大。
海边总是刮风。

defsEn: n. duration of service
n. the property of being long-lived
zh: n. 长命, 长寿, 寿命
examples: If you aim for longevity, think about giving up smoking.
The quality, not the longevity, of one's life is what is important.

defsEn: n. in ancient Greek mythology any of 9 daughters of Zeus and Mnemosyne
protector of an art or science
n. the source of an artist's inspiration
zh: n. 沉思, 冥想
v. 沉思, 冥想, 若有所思地凝望或说
examples: I let my muse inspire me.
I mused on the meaning of his painting.

defsEn: n. someone who has insufficient assets to cover their debts
v. reduce to bankruptcy
s. financially ruined
zh: n. 破产者
a. 破产的
vt. 使破产
examples: The company went bankrupt. We laid off all of the employees.
The company's going to go bankrupt really soon.
exampleZh: 公司倒闭了。我们遣散了所有员工。
公司很快就要倒闭了。

defsEn: r. in an intellectual manner
zh: adv. 智力上；知性上；理智地
examples: We can grow intellectually through reading.
Intellectually we know prejudice is wrong.

defsEn: s. involving or constituting a cause
causing
zh: a. 原因的, 因果关系的, 表示原因或理由的
n. 表示原因的连词
examples: What is the difference between a causal relationship and a casual relationship?

defsEn: n. an individual instance of a type of symbol
n. something serving as a sign of something else
n. a metal or plastic disk that can be redeemed or used in designated slot machines
zh: n. 表征, 记号, 代币
a. 象征的, 表意的
examples: Do you have a token for the shopping trolley?
May I present this to you in token of my appreciation?

defsEn: n. the weight of a frail (basket) full of raisins or figs
between 50 and 75 pounds
n. a basket for holding dried fruit (especially raisins or figs)
a. physically weak
zh: a. 脆弱的, 虚弱的, 意志薄弱的
n. 少女, 少妇, 灯心草篓
examples: He's as frail as a baby goat.
He's become frail in his old age.

defsEn: n. any red eruption of the skin
n. a series of unexpected and unpleasant occurrences
s. imprudently incurring risk
zh: a. 轻率的, 匆忙的, 鲁莽的
n. 皮疹
examples: I have a rash on my neck.
I have a rash on my hand.

defsEn: r. everywhere
zh: adv. 宇宙, 全世界, 普遍, 一般, 普通, 全体, 一致, 通用, 万能, 广用, 广泛
examples: That's a universally human experience that repeats over and over.
You will be universally praised for speaking the truth.

defsEn: a. of or pertaining to or typical of Europe
a. of or relating to or concerning the American colonies during and immediately after the American Revolutionary War
a. of or relating to or characteristic of a continent
a. being or concerning or limited to a continent especially the continents of North America or Europe
zh: a. 大陆的, 洲的
n. 欧洲大陆人
examples: They serve a continental breakfast in this hotel.
The largest continental lake in the world is the Caspian Sea.

defsEn: n a small book usually having a paper cover
n a brief treatise on a subject of interest
published in the form of a booklet
zh: n. 小册子, 活页文选
examples: This pamphlet is free of charge.
Could you please send me a pamphlet?
exampleZh: 这本小册子是免费的。

defsEn: n. club soda or fruit juice used to mix with alcohol
n. electronic equipment that mixes two or more input signals to give a single output signal
n. a kitchen utensil that is used for mixing foods
zh: n. 混合者, 混合器, 搅拌机, 搅拌器, 混频器, (非正式)交际家, 与人相处的人
examples: Remove the beaters from the mixer before you lick them.
I met my wife at a mixer party.

defsEn: n. dried grape
zh: n. 葡萄干
examples: Why do you not eat raisins?
He sprinkled raisin on top of the couscous.

defsEn: v. record in chronological order
make a historical record
zh: n. 年代记, 记录, 编年史
vt. 把...载入编年史
examples: That old chronicle is on the left.
The chronicle of the kingdom describes the rtigns of the ancient kings.

defsEn: n the testing of an idea
n the act of conducting a controlled test or investigation
zh: n. 实验, 试验, 实验法
examples: How open is he to experimentation?
She encourages experimentation in every project.

defsEn: n. the act of hauling something (as a vehicle) by means of a hitch or rope
v. drag behind
zh: n. 拖, 拖绳, 拖轮
vt. 拖, 拉, 牵引
examples: The policeman didn't tow your car away.
I need to call a tow truck.
exampleZh: 警察没有拖走你的车。

defsEn: n. sudden reddening of the face (as from embarrassment or guilt or shame or modesty)
v. turn red, as if in embarrassment or shame
v. become rosy or reddish
zh: vi. 脸红, 羞愧
vt. 弄成红色
n. 脸红
examples: The man blushed like a boy.
Bob is very timid and blushes when chatting with girls.
exampleZh: 男人的脸像小孩般红了起来。
鲍伯非常胆小，和女生聊天时会脸红。

defsEn: n. the act of making something different (as e.g. the size of a garment)
zh: n. 变更, 改动
examples: The plan is incapable of alteration.

defsEn: n. a mechanical device on a camera that opens and closes to control the time of a photographic exposure
n. a hinged blind for a window
v. close with shutters
zh: n. 百叶窗, 关闭物, 照相机快门, 关闭者
vt. 为...装百叶窗, 以百叶窗遮闭
examples: Through a gap in the shutters, people can be seen standing in the street.
The shutter's over here. All you have to do is press it.

defsEn: v. fill with apprehension or alarm
cause to be unpleasantly surprised
zh: n. 沮丧
vt. 使惊愕, 使气馁
examples: Tom gave a cry of dismay.
This mysterious catastrophe dismayed the whole village.
exampleZh: 汤姆失望地叫了起来。

defsEn: n. a preserve made of the jelled juice of fruit
n. any substance having the consistency of jelly or gelatin
zh: n. 果冻, 果冻甜食, 胶状物
v. (使)结冻, (使)成胶状
examples: Will you be the jelly in my peanut butter sandwich?
Would you like a Jelly Baby?

defsEn: n. the part of a song where a soloist is joined by a group of singers
v. resist doing something
zh: n. 重复的话, 叠句, 副歌
vi. 节制, 避免, 克制
examples: Please refrain from smoking in the elevator.
She could not refrain from tears.
exampleZh: 电梯内不准吸烟。
她不得不哭。

defsEn: n. someone who journeys in foreign lands
n. one of the colonists from England who sailed to America on the Mayflower and founded the colony of Plymouth in New England in 1620
n. someone who journeys to a sacred place as an act of religious devotion
zh: n. 旅行者, 朝圣者, 香客
vi. 朝圣
examples: The pilgrims entered the ancient fane to offer their prayers.
The party of pilgrims started for Shikoku.

defsEn: n. a basket usually with a cover
v. prevent the progress or free movement of
zh: n. 食篮, 阻碍物, 食盒
vt. 阻碍, 使困累, 妨碍, 牵制
examples: Put your dirty laundry in the hamper, not on the floor.
Please be quiet and don't hamper my work.

defsEn: a. pleasant-smelling
zh: a. 芬香的, 馥郁的, 愉快的
examples: She planted fragrant olives in the garden.
A fragrant breeze wafted from the garden.
exampleZh: 她在花园里种了桂花。

defsEn: n. a ceremonial dinner party for many people
n. a meal that is well prepared and greatly enjoyed
zh: n. 宴会
examples: There's a banquet I have to go to tonight.
Will you be taking part in the banquet?

defsEn: n. a stable situation in which forces cancel one another
n. a sensory system located in structures of the inner ear that registers the orientation of the head
zh: n. 平衡, 平静, 均衡
examples: We could apply the theory of punctuated equilibrium to languages.
How can we define equilibrium for a system of moving particles?
exampleZh: 我们可以把间断平衡理论应用到语言上。

defsEn: s displaying luxury and furnishing gratification to the senses
s rich and superior in quality
zh: a. 豪华的, 奢侈的, 放纵的
examples: She used to wear luxurious clothing.
They are rich. They live in a luxurious mansion by the sea.

defsEn: n. a member of the middle class
s. (according to Marxist thought) being of the property-owning class and exploitive of the working class
s. conforming to the standards and conventions of the middle class
s. belonging to the middle class
zh: n. 中产阶级分子, 商人, 资产阶级
a. 中产阶级的, 平庸的
n. 九点活字
examples: It's a piece of bourgeois furniture.
The French Revolution was a bourgeois revolt.

defsEn: n. infection transmitted by inhalation or ingestion of tubercle bacilli and manifested in fever and small lesions (usually in the lungs but in various other parts of the body in acute stages)
zh: n. 肺结核
examples: I'm on preventative medication for tuberculosis.
Tuberculosis patients were sent to a special hospital called a sanatorium.

defsEn: n. a lighting fixture that uses a fluorescent lamp
s. emitting light during exposure to radiation from an external source
s. brilliantly colored and apparently giving off light
zh: n. 荧光
a. 荧光的
examples: I must replace that fluorescent lamp.
The lamp had a fluorescent light.

defsEn: n. a tropical American plant bearing a large fleshy edible fruit with a terminal tuft of stiff leaves
widely cultivated in the tropics
n. large sweet fleshy tropical fruit with a terminal tuft of stiff leaves
widely cultivated
zh: n. 凤梨, 菠萝, 失业救济金
examples: How much is the kilo of pineapple?
Please, give me the biggest pineapple.
exampleZh: 菠萝一公斤多少钱？
请给我最大的菠萝。

defsEn: n. (chemistry) a reaction in which an elementary substance displaces and sets free a constituent element from a compound
n. (psychiatry) a defense mechanism that transfers affect or reaction from the original object to some more acceptable one
n. to move something from its natural environment
zh: n. 换置, 移位, 移动, 取代
examples: Displacements should be kept to a strict minimum.

defsEn: v kill in large numbers
v destroy completely, as if down to the roots
zh: vt. 根除, 扑灭, 根绝, 消灭
examples: We must eradicate the drug traffic, root and branch.
It is urgent to eradicate poverty in Africa.

defsEn: v. enlarge or increase
v. grow or intensify
zh: v. 增加, 增长
examples: Jugurtha sought to augment his power.
This technology is called augmented reality.

defsEn: n. a fortified defensive structure
zh: n. 城堡, 要塞
vt. 筑要塞, 以要塞防守
examples: The author of Fortress Besieged is Qian Zhongshu.
You can look at a fortress there.
exampleZh: 《围城》的作者是钱钟书。

defsEn: v. make safe
v. escort safely
zh: n. 保卫, 保护措施, 防护设施
vt. 保卫, 保护
examples: I aim to safeguard my heart.
The safeguard of the state shall be the supreme law.

defsEn: n. ammunition consisting of a cylindrical casing containing an explosive charge and a bullet
fired from a rifle or handgun
n. a module designed to be inserted into a larger piece of equipment
n. an electro-acoustic transducer that is the part of the arm of a record player that holds the needle and that is removable
zh: n. 弹药筒, 弹药, 一卷软片, 墨粉鼓
examples: The police found a cartridge case next to the body.
Can you repair the faucet cartridge or should we replace it?

defsEn: n. money that is risked for possible monetary gain
n. a risky act or venture
v. take a risk in the hope of a favorable outcome
v. play games for money
zh: n. 赌博, 冒险
v. 赌博, 孤注一掷
examples: Promise you will not gamble again.
Are you sure you want to gamble that much money on one horse race?

defsEn: n. a scientific instrument consisting of displays and an input device that an operator can use to monitor and control a system (especially a computer system)
n. an ornamental scroll-shaped bracket (especially one used to support a wall fixture)
zh: vt. 安慰, 藉慰
n. 控制台
examples: What console do you play on?
Do not set the console other than in the vertical or horizontal position.

defsEn: n. a song of praise (to God or to a saint or to a nation)
v. sing a hymn
v. praise by singing a hymn
zh: n. 赞美诗, 圣歌
v. 唱赞美歌
examples: The morning service began with a hymn.
Life is a hymn; sing it!

defsEn: a. showing respect for the rights or opinions or practices of others
s. able to tolerate environmental conditions or physiological stress
s. showing the capacity for endurance
zh: a. 宽容的, 容忍的, (对冷、热)能耐的
examples: It is said that Dutch are tolerant.
Always try to be tolerant and patient.
exampleZh: 人们常说荷兰人很宽容。

defsEn: n. an upward movement (especially a rhythmical rising and falling)
n. (geology) a horizontal dislocation
n. the act of lifting something with great effort
n. an involuntary spasm of ineffectual vomiting
zh: n. 举, 抛, 起伏, 鼓起
vt. 用力举起, 使举起, 使鼓起
vi. 抛出, 起伏, 喘息, 凸起
examples: She heaved a sigh of relief when she heard the good news.
This ship is outfitted with a windlass to heave up the anchor.

defsEn: n. lack of attention and due care
n. willful lack of care and attention
zh: n. 忽视, 漠视
vt. 忽视, 不顾
examples: Disregarding the "No Entry" sign, she pushed open the door and walked inside.
I must admit at once that I disregard the rule.
exampleZh: 无视于" 禁止进入" 的牌子，她推开了门走进去。

defsEn: n. any of several breeds of dog used for hunting typically having large drooping ears
v. pursue or chase relentlessly
zh: n. 猎犬
vt. 带猎犬狩猎, 追捕, 激励, 使追逐
examples: The hound was in full chase of the bear.
Hounds hunt by their keen scent.

defsEn: n. a sedimentary rock consisting mainly of calcium that was deposited by the remains of marine animals
zh: n. 石灰石
examples: Limestone underlies most of the site.
The piping is clogged up because of the limestone.

defsEn: v cause to be alert and energetic
v raise to a higher energy level
zh: vt. 使活跃, 激励, 供给...能量
examples: Jogging in the morning energizes me for the whole day.
He felt energized during the workout.

defsEn: r. as a matter of instinct
zh: adv. 本能地, 直觉地
examples: The turtle hatchlings instinctively make their way towards the sea.
I knew instinctively what to do.

defsEn: n. any writing that is regarded as sacred by a religious group
zh: n. 圣经, 圣经的一节, 圣经的一句, 铭文
examples: Throughout the Scriptures, we find this usage of the number forty.
India's ancient scriptures and philosophical teachings offer profound wisdom and spiritual guidance.

defsEn: a. open and observable
not secret or hidden
zh: a. 明显的, 公然的, 蓄意的
examples: There is no overt sign of damage.

defsEn: a. (of hair) having curls or waves
zh: a. 拳曲的, 卷毛的, 弯曲的
examples: He had a round, curly beard and not a single gray hair.
The daughter with the curly hair is my daughter.

defsEn: n. a copy that corresponds to an original exactly
v. make or do or perform again
v. make a duplicate or duplicates of
s. identically copied from an original
zh: n. 副本, 复本, 复制品
a. 复制的, 二重的
vt. 复制, 使加倍
examples: This contract is made in duplicate.
I left a duplicate key to the room with my mother.
exampleZh: 本合同一式两份。

defsEn: a. not reasonable
not showing good judgment
zh: a. 不合理的, 过度的, 不切实际的
examples: She asked me for an unreasonable sum of money.
It would be completely unreasonable to do such a thing.

defsEn: s. marked by excessive or uncontrollable emotion
zh: a. 歇斯底里的, 异常兴奋的
examples: There's no need to get hysterical.
I could hear shrieks of hysterical laughter spilling from the other room.

defsEn: n. an animal that has strayed (especially a domestic animal)
v. wander from a direct course or at random
s. (of an animal) having no home or having wandered away from home
zh: n. 走失的家畜, 浪子
a. 迷途的, 偶然的
vi. 迷路, 彷徨, 流浪
examples: Tom has found another stray dog.
I found a stray sock under the bed.
exampleZh: 汤姆又遇到野狗。

defsEn: n. a soldier who drives a tank
zh: n. 坦克手, 油船, 空中加油飞机, 运油飞机, 油槽/水槽汽车
examples: A huge tanker cast off just now.
A huge tanker just pulled out from the dock.
exampleZh: 一艘巨大的液货船刚刚启航。
一艘巨大的液货船刚刚启航。

defsEn: n. money granted (by a university or foundation or other agency) for advanced study or research
zh: n. 伙伴关系, 共同参与, 团体, 奖学金, 友谊
examples: He longs for the fellowship of the rich.
And have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather reprove them.

defsEn: n. the occurrence of surplus liquid (as water) exceeding the limit or capacity
v. flow or run over (a limit or brim)
zh: n. 溢值, 超值, 泛滥
v. (使)泛滥, (使)溢出, (使)充溢
examples: Out of the overflow of the heart, the mouth speaks.
The river overflowed because of the heavy rain.

defsEn: s. very unpleasant
zh: a. 可怕的
examples: The consequences of Sendai's earthquake were dreadful!
What a dreadful way to die!
exampleZh: 仙台地震的结果很恐怖。

defsEn: v. be sufficient
be adequate, either in quality or quantity
zh: vi. 足够, 有能力
vt. 满足
examples: A yes or a no would suffice.
Suffice to say it was a horrible night.

defsEn: n. a system of words used to name things in a particular discipline
zh: n. 术语, 术语学
examples: Legal terminology is not comprehensible to most laypeople.
He'll get used to the terminology.
exampleZh: 法律术语是大多数普通人无法理解的。

defsEn: a. not transmitting or reflecting light or radiant energy
impenetrable to sight
s. not clearly understood or expressed
zh: n. 不透明物
a. 不透明的, 不传热的, 不传导的, 阴暗的
examples: Opaque? Not at all. Intuitively obvious to the most casual observer.
The truth is opaque and consequently imperceptible.

defsEn: n. something that is a source of danger
n. a threat or the act of threatening
v. express a threat either by an utterance or a gesture
v. act in a threatening manner
zh: n. 威胁, 胁迫
v. 威吓, 胁迫
examples: A strange man menaced her with a knife.
It's a menace at my school.

defsEn: n. an angry disturbance
v. worry unnecessarily or excessively
zh: n. 大惊小怪, 小题大作, 忙乱
vi. 无事自扰, 焦急, 焦燥, 忙乱
vt. 使激动, 使烦燥
examples: The less fuss made the better, in my opinion.
She made a fuss for no good reason.

defsEn: n a form of government in which the ruler is an absolute dictator (not restricted by a constitution or laws or opposition etc.)
n dominance through threat of punishment and violence
zh: n. 专制, 暴政
examples: The Republican Party is a tyranny of the minority.
Democracy is the tyranny of the majority.

defsEn: r. in a vivid manner
zh: adv. 鲜艳, 强烈, 明亮, 鲜明, 活泼, 有生气, 生动, 清晰, 逼真
examples: I vividly remember my first kiss.
I remember the event as vividly as if it were just yesterday.

defsEn: n. a criminal who is a member of gang
zh: n. 流氓, 歹徒
examples: I saw a gangster lying in the light from the hall.
The gangster tried to kill the witness.

defsEn: n a force that moves something along
n the act of applying force suddenly
zh: n. 动力, 推动力, 动量
examples: What gave you the impetus to change?
If there's no reward, what's the impetus to return their dog?

defsEn: n. the sound of a sudden heavy fall
v. give support (to) or make a choice (of) one out of a group or number
r. straight down especially heavily or abruptly
zh: a. 圆胖的, 丰满的, 直接下落的, 直率的
vt. 突然放下, 支持, 使丰满, 使鼓起
vi. 扑通落下, 投票赞成, 变丰满, 鼓起
adv. 沉重地, 突然地, 直截了当地
examples: I may be plump, but I'm vigorous.
He always tended to be plump.

defsEn: n. largest anthropoid ape
terrestrial and vegetarian
of forests of central west Africa
zh: n. 大猩猩, 残暴的男人, 歹徒
examples: Koko is not an ordinary gorilla.
How much could a gorilla bench press?
exampleZh: 可可不是一只普通的猩猩。

defsEn: n. the state of being assimilated
people of different backgrounds come to see themselves as part of a larger national family
n. the social process of absorbing one cultural group into harmony with another
n. the process of absorbing nutrients into the body after digestion
zh: n. 同化, 同化作用, 吸收
examples: Algerians don't want cultural assimilation with Western nations.

defsEn: n. someone who carves the meat
n. someone whose work is cutting (as e.g. cutting cloth for garments)
n. a sailing vessel with a single mast set further back than the mast of a sloop
n. a cutting implement
a tool for cutting
zh: n. 裁剪者, 切割者, 切割器
examples: Fyodor cut the rope with a cutter.
Yanni works as a meat cutter.

defsEn: n. an industrial plant for purifying a crude substance
zh: n. 精炼厂
examples: How safe is the refinery where you work?
Relax, the refinery isn't going to blow up because of some small earthquake.

defsEn: a. obvious to the eye or mind
zh: a. 显著的, 显眼的, 出众的
examples: The scar on his forehead is conspicuous.
He was conspicuous by his absence.
exampleZh: 他额头上的疤痕很醒目。

defsEn: r under normal conditions
zh: adv. 通常, 普通, 一般地
examples: Ordinarily, Tom will eat lunch at the school cafeteria.
Ordinarily, urban planners do not view pedestrians as important traffic.

defsEn: s without mercy or pity
zh: a. 无情的, 残忍的, 毫不留情的, 彻底的
examples: In the face of ruthless competition, our business failed to survive.
Your ruthless actions left no room for mercy.

defsEn: v. declare illegal
outlaw
zh: n. 被剥夺法律保护的人, 罪犯
vt. 使...失去法律保护, 将...逐出社会, 宣告非法, 取缔
examples: You want to outlaw child labor? What are you, a Communist?
The outlaw left a note in the saloon.

defsEn: n. someone who communicates by waving
n. the act of moving back and forth
v. sway to and fro
zh: n. 动摇, 踌躇, 挥动者
vi. 摇摆, 颤抖, 摆动, 摇曳, 犹豫
examples: She never wavered in her faith in him.
His gaze never wavered, steady as stone.

defsEn: n. someone who performs magic tricks to amuse an audience
zh: n. 魔术家, 幻术家, 术士
examples: I want to be a magician.
Sami is not good at being a magician.
exampleZh: 我想成为一个魔法师。
萨米不是个好的魔术师。

defsEn: n. knowledge of the future (usually said to be obtained from a divine source)
n. a prediction uttered under divine inspiration
zh: n. 预言, 预言能力
examples: She has a gift for prophecy.
Speak the prophecy: disaster comes soon!
exampleZh: 她有预言的能力。

defsEn: v. give as a gift
zh: vt. 授予, 使用, 贮藏, 留宿
examples: He bestowed a large amount of money on the institute.
He bestows salvation, but you sink down into death.

defsEn: v. become similar to one's environment
v. make similar
v. take (gas, light or heat) into a solution
v. become similar in sound
zh: vt. 使同化, 吸收, 使相拟, 把...比作
vi. 被吸收, 被同化
examples: You must assimilate into new surroundings.
The weak easily assimilate the opinions of the strong.

defsEn: n. a piece of soft material that covers and protects an injured part of the body
v. dress by covering or binding
zh: n. 绷带
examples: He wound a bandage around the wound.
You can take off the bandage tomorrow.
exampleZh: 他用绷带包扎了伤口。

defsEn: n. a protective covering that protects an inside surface
n. providing something with a surface of a different material
n. the act of attaching an inside lining (to a garment or curtain etc.)
zh: n. 衬里, 内层, 衬垫
examples: They are lining up for the bus.
There is a silver lining to every dark cloud!
exampleZh: 他们排队等公车。

defsEn: n. lifting device for raising heavy or cumbersome objects
v. raise or haul up with or as if with mechanical help
v. move from one place to another by lifting
v. raise
zh: n. 升高, 起重机, 推动
v. 升起, 升高, 举起
examples: Hoist your sail when the wind is fair.
This hoist is used to lift heavy car parts.

defsEn: n. a twisted and tangled mass that is highly interwoven
n. something jumbled or confused
zh: n. 缠结, 纠结的一团, 困惑, 纠纷, 混乱
vt. 使缠结, 缠住
vi. 缠结, 乱作一团
examples: I wish I could tangle your hair into beautiful braids.
My head has become a tangle of confusion.

defsEn: v. lengthen in time
cause to be or last longer
v. lengthen or extend in duration or space
zh: vt. 延长, 拖延, 拖长
examples: Prolonging the discussion will bring us nowhere.
The happiness of a person prolongs his day.
exampleZh: 继续讨论下去，也不会有什么结果。

defsEn: n. the property of tasting as if it contains sugar
zh: n. 甜蜜, 芳香, 美妙
examples: Death has but sweetness for a Christian soul.
Her voice is full of sweetness.

defsEn: v pass from physical life and lose all bodily attributes and functions necessary to sustain life
zh: vi. 毁灭, 丧生, 凋谢, 颓丧, 死亡, 腐烂
vt. 毁坏, 使麻木, 使丧生, 耗尽
examples: Why, if man must perish, is he born?
It is better to plead than to perish.
exampleZh: 如果人注定死去的话，那为什么要出生呢？

defsEn: n. a surrounding or nearby region
zh: n. 附近, 邻近, 附近地区, 近处
examples: We live in the vicinity of the school.
You should stay out of his vicinity.
exampleZh: 我们住在学校附近。

defsEn: v. walk impeded by some physical limitation or injury
v. proceed slowly or with difficulty
s. not firm
s. lacking in strength or firmness or resilience
zh: n. 跛行
a. 柔软的, 无力的, 软弱的
vi. 跛行
examples: The limp figure lay still on the bed.
Did you get your limp during the war?

defsEn: n. a cutaneous sensation often resulting from light stroking
n. the act of tickling
v. touch (a body part) lightly so as to excite the surface nerves and cause uneasiness, laughter, or spasmodic movements
v. touch or stroke lightly
zh: n. 胳肢, 痒
vt. 胳肢, 使发痒, 使快乐, 逗乐
vi. 觉得痒, 使人痒
examples: If you tickle us, do we not laugh?
The mother tickled her child with a feather.

defsEn: v. lessen the strength or flavor of a solution or mixture
zh: vt. 冲淡, 稀释
a. 淡的, 稀释的
examples: You have to dilute it with water.
Can I use this solvent to dilute my sample?

defsEn: v. travel up, "We ascended the mountain"
v. go back in order of genealogical succession
v. become king or queen
v. appear to be moving upward, as by means of tendrils
zh: vi. 上升, 追溯, 登高
vt. 攀登
examples: This mountain path ascends to the beautiful lake.
The smoke ascended into the air.

defsEn: v. grant relief or an exemption from a rule or requirement to
a. (of persons) freed from or not subject to an obligation or liability (as e.g. taxes) to which others or other things are subject
zh: n. 免税者, 被免除义务者
a. 免除的
vt. 使免除, 豁免
examples: Nothing is exempt from Murphy's Law.
My refusal to explain exempts me from the poll.
exampleZh: 没有任何事物能逃脱墨菲定律。

defsEn: n. radiation lying in the ultraviolet range
wave lengths shorter than light but longer than X rays
s. having or employing wavelengths shorter than light but longer than X-rays
lying outside the visible spectrum at its violet end
zh: a. 紫外线的
examples: Ultraviolet rays can cause skin cancer.
Infrared and ultraviolet light are invisible to the human eye.
exampleZh: 紫外线可导致皮肤癌。

defsEn: r. towards the shore from the water
zh: adv. 向岸, 在岸上
examples: Our boat drifted ashore on the tide.
Instead of going ashore, we stayed on the ship.

defsEn: s. having four right angles
zh: a. 成直角的
examples: A polar bear is a rectangular bear after a coordinate transform.
His plot of land is rectangular in shape.

defsEn: n. the act of persuading (or attempting to persuade)
communication intended to induce belief or action
zh: n. 说服, 信念, 派别, 说服力
examples: Finally, he gave in to my persuasion.
Finally, he gave into my persuasion.

defsEn: n the act of abrogating
an official or legal cancellation
v cancel officially
zh: n. 废止, 撤消
vt. 废止, 撤消, 放弃
examples: We demand the repeal of this law.
I think they should repeal that law.

defsEn: v issue or terminate (in a specified way, state, etc.)
end
zh: vi. 跟着发生, 继起
vt. 追求
examples: An argument ensued and he slit her throat.
Much confusion ensued following this news report.

defsEn: n. the reasoning involved in drawing a conclusion or making a logical judgment on the basis of circumstantial evidence and prior conclusions rather than on the basis of direct observation
zh: n. 推论
examples: Is this an observation or an inference?
You must draw inferences but not speculate.

defsEn: v. increase in size, volume or significance
zh: vt. 放大, 扩大, 赞美, 夸大
vi. 有放大能力
examples: You can use a magnifying glass to magnify small text.
Do you have a magnifying glass that I could borrow?

defsEn: n a person who settles in a new colony or moves into new country
zh: n. 殖民地居民, 移民
examples: This outfit was typical of a colonist at that time.
How could the colonists declare independence? I think that's against common sense.

defsEn: v. learn or discover with certainty
zh: vt. 确定, 查明
examples: We will first ascertain the cause of the disaster.
Ascertain whether they are safe or not.

defsEn: n. professional wrongdoing that results in injury or damage
n. a wrongful act that the actor had no right to do
improper professional conduct
zh: n. 不当治疗, 不端行为, 渎职
examples: Malpractice insurance is a contributing factor to the high cost of medical care.

defsEn: a. of or relating to or used in microscopy
s. visible under a microscope
using a microscope
s. extremely precise with great attention to details
s. so small as to be invisible without a microscope
zh: a. 显微镜的, 用显微镜可见的, 微观的, (非正式)极微小的, 细微的
examples: We just looked at a microscopic piece of sponge through a microscope.
What am I but a microscopic and temporary contraction of Infinite Space?

defsEn: v. turn from a straight course, fixed direction, or line of interest
v. turn aside and away from an initial or intended course
zh: vt. 转移, 使偏斜
vi. 偏斜
examples: Deflect any question related to your personal life.
The ball must be deflected before its path will change.

defsEn: s softly bright or radiant
zh: a. 发光的, 明亮的
examples: Tom wants to paint the windowsills with luminous paint.

defsEn: s of high moral or intellectual value
elevated in nature or style
s of imposing height
especially standing out above others
s having or displaying great dignity or nobility
zh: a. 高的, 傲慢的, 崇高的, 高级的, 玄虚的
examples: We have lofty ambitions for this project.
That's to me like a flower on lofty heights.

defsEn: n. a large bottle with a narrow mouth
n. the quantity contained in a jug
v. stew in an earthenware jug
zh: n. 水壶, 监牢, 模仿夜莺的叫声
vt. 放入壶中, 炖, 关押
vi. 模仿夜莺叫
examples: Take the jug to the dining room.
Give me that jug of water.

defsEn: v. spread or diffuse through
zh: vt. 弥漫, 渗透, 充满, 影响, 感染
vi. 透入, 散布
examples: The air was permeated by the smell of the sea.
A bad smell permeated the room.
exampleZh: 空气中充斥着海的气息。

defsEn: s. bordering on or living or characteristic of those near the sea
zh: a. 海的, 海上的, 海事的, 沿海的, 海员的
examples: They went to the maritime museum.
Is there a difference between admiralty and maritime law?

defsEn: n. the short low gruff noise of the kind made by hogs
n. an unskilled or low-ranking soldier or other worker
n. medium-sized tropical marine food fishes that utter grunting sounds when caught
v. issue a grunting, low, animal-like noise
zh: vi. 作呼噜声
vt. 咕哝
n. 呼噜声, 咕哝
examples: With a grunt, he left the bar upset and ashamed.
Wild boar grunt if you get close to them.

defsEn: v. inform
zh: vt. 使认识, 介绍
examples: Mr Smith and I have been acquainted with each other for a long time.
I got acquainted with her in France.
exampleZh: Smith 先生和我是老相识。
我在法国认识了她。

defsEn: v. cause great unhappiness for
distress
v. cause physical pain or suffering in
zh: vt. 使苦恼, 折磨
examples: I dread being afflicted by that dangerous sickness.
I will be afflicted that I do not know men.

defsEn: n. vegetation (such as young shoots, twigs, and leaves) that is suitable for animals to eat
n. reading superficially or at random
n. the act of feeding by continual nibbling
v. look around casually and randomly, without seeking anything in particular
zh: v. 浏览, 吃草
n. 浏览, 吃草
examples: If I could, I would browse the web all day.
When I browse the web, I read a lot of webpages.

defsEn: v. travel across or pass over
v. deny formally (an allegation of fact by the opposing party) in a legal suit
zh: n. 越过, 横贯, 横断物, 屏障, 否认, 反驳
vt. 横过, 穿过, 经过, 详细研究, 反对, 在...来回移动
vi. 横越, 横断, 旋转, 来回移动
a. 横亘的, 横贯的
examples: That's an area that's impossible to traverse on foot.
Traverse City is in the divot between the pinky finger and the ring finger.

defsEn: n. active strength of body or mind
zh: n. 精力, 活力
examples: He is always full of vigor.
The mare set off again with renewed vigor.

defsEn: v. transmit (knowledge or skills)
v. transmit or serve as the medium for transmission
zh: vt. 给予, 传授, 告知
examples: Will you impart the secret to me?
Let me impart these few words of wisdom to you.

defsEn: v. refer to another person for decision or judgment
v. assign to a class or kind
zh: vt. 驱逐, 使降低地位, 把...归类, 把...委托给
examples: Don't relegate me to the back office. I want to talk to the customers.
This issue has been relegated to the background.

defsEn: v. use as a quantifier
v. express as a number or measure or quantity
zh: vt. 定量, 用数量表示, 测量
examples: It's difficult to quantify how bright her personality is.
Quantifying public opinion is often the first step to solving an important problem.

defsEn: s. lacking in substance
zh: a. 有影的, 暗黑的, 朦胧的, 虚幻的
examples: It's getting more and more shadowy, soon it will be twilight.
Ziri saw a shadowy creature in the corner of the room.

defsEn: n. a vertical structure that divides or separates (as a wall divides one room from another)
n. (computer science) the part of a hard disk that is dedicated to a particular operating system or application and accessed as a single unit
n. (anatomy) a structure that separates areas in an organism
v. divide into parts, pieces, or sections
zh: n. 分割, 隔离物, 隔墙, 财产分割
vt. 区分, 瓜分, 隔开, 分割
examples: I need to partition my hard drive.
Traditional Javanese villages partitioned their most essential resource into house land and rice land.

defsEn: s radiating or as if radiating light
zh: a. 发光的, 明亮的, 辐射的, 容光焕发的
examples: Her face was radiant with happiness.
His face was radiant with happiness.

defsEn: n. fortitude and determination
n. the part of a network that connects other networks together
zh: n. 脊椎, 志气, 骨干, 支柱
examples: Will he have the backbone to speak out against the bill?
Woman is the backbone of every society.

defsEn: v. live a life of pleasure, especially with respect to alcoholic consumption
zh: vt. 散失, 驱散, 浪费
vi. 消散, 放荡
examples: The fog dissipated as the sun rose.
Sami dissipated his rage through the use of violence.

defsEn: n. any compound of oxygen with another element or a radical
zh: n. 氧化物
examples: Nitrous oxide stopped being used as an anaesthetic a long time ago.
Corundum is a form of aluminum oxide.

defsEn: s. designed to incite to indecency or lust
zh: a. 淫秽的, 猥亵的, 讨人厌的, 可憎的
examples: We were spending an obscene amount of money.
For me, it's an obscene art.

defsEn: n. a small and inadequate amount
zh: n. 缺乏, 不足, 缺少
examples: There seems to be a scarcity of Austrian chat rooms in the Web.
Water scarcity has become more common in Algeria.

defsEn: n. a process in which a substance reacts with oxygen to give heat and light
n. a state of violent disturbance and excitement
zh: n. 燃烧, 骚动
examples: Internal combustion engines burn a mixture of fuel and air.
Tom explained how an internal-combustion engine worked.

defsEn: n a midday meal
zh: n. 午宴, 午餐会
examples: We asked ten people to the luncheon.
It was a good luncheon, as hotels go.

defsEn: v make worse
v exasperate or irritate
zh: vt. 使恶化, 使更严重, 加重
examples: The long trip aggravated her injury.
The problem was aggravated by a lack of communication.

defsEn: n. relatively permanent disorder of the mind
zh: n. 疯狂, 愚顽, 精神错乱
examples: The insanity of the situation made him laugh.
Not considering your offer would be insanity.

defsEn: n. the rate of flow of energy or particles across a given surface
n. a flow or discharge
n. a substance added to molten metals to bond with impurities that can then be readily removed
n. excessive discharge of liquid from a cavity or organ (as in watery diarrhea)
zh: n. 流出, 涨潮, 变迁
vi. 熔化, 流出
vt. 使熔融
examples: Our plans are in a state of flux.
Fluence is the time integral of flux.

defsEn: a. of or relating to the function or responsibility or activity of management
zh: a. 管理的
examples: My classmate, Xiao Ming, has strong managerial capability.
He was advanced to a managerial post.
exampleZh: 小明同学管理能力很强。

defsEn: n. a structure consisting of an area that has been enclosed for some purpose
n. the act of enclosing something inside something else
n. a naturally enclosed space
n. something (usually a supporting document) that is enclosed in an envelope with a covering letter
zh: n. 附件, 围墙, 围绕
examples: Ziri put the tortoise in the enclosure.
The bull broke out of the enclosure.

defsEn: a. relating to the mood of verbs that is used simple in declarative statements
s. (usually followed by `of') pointing out or revealing clearly
zh: a. 指示的, 象征的, 表示...的
examples: A high forehead is indicative of great mental power.
Macedonian has four verbal moods: indicative, conditional, imperative, and renarrative.

defsEn: n. the state of having been made use of
zh: n. 利用
examples: Credit utilization constitutes a significant portion of a credit score.
They are thinking about the utilization of plastic bags in the country.

defsEn: v. be on one's guard
be cautious or wary about
be alert to
zh: v. 小心, 谨防
examples: Beware of anyone who claims objectivity.
Beware of anybody who claims objectivity.
exampleZh: 要小心那些说自己客观的人。
要小心那些说自己客观的人。

defsEn: n. intense anger (usually on an epic scale)
n. belligerence aroused by a real or supposed wrong (personified as one of the deadly sins)
zh: n. 愤怒, 激怒, 愤怒的举动, (自然现象等)严酷
examples: He could not contain his wrath.
My wrath shall far exceed the love I ever bore.

defsEn: s. having precise or logical relevance to the matter at hand
zh: a. 相关的, 中肯的, 切题的
examples: Could you please summarize the pertinent points?
He asked a few pertinent questions.

defsEn: v. give qualities or abilities to
v. furnish with an endowment
zh: vt. 捐赠, 捐助, 赋予
examples: He is endowed with unusual ability in mathematics.
Nature endowed her with both a sound mind and a sound body.
exampleZh: 他天生具有不寻常的数学能力。

defsEn: n the particular occupation for which you are trained
n a body of people doing the same kind of work
zh: n. 职业, 天命, 天职, 才能, 行业
examples: Never choose a vocation just because it promises social standing.
Never choose a vocation just because it looks easy.

defsEn: n. handling an operation that involves providing labor and materials be supplied as needed
zh: n. 后勤学, 后勤
examples: I asked the logistics department if they could supply us with more equipment.
He is in charge of the logistics of the military operation.

defsEn: s. combining clever conception and facetious expression
zh: a. 富于机智的, 诙谐的
examples: He said it for the sake of a witty remark.
They're not as witty as they used to be.

defsEn: n. the act of obeying
dutiful or submissive behavior with respect to another person
n. the trait of being willing to obey
n. behavior intended to please your parents
zh: n. 服从, 顺从, 忠实
examples: The duty of a daughter is in obedience.
Don't interpret their silence as obedience.

defsEn: n. agitation resulting from active worry
n. an ornamental pattern consisting of repeated vertical and horizontal lines (often in relief)
n. a small bar of metal across the fingerboard of a musical instrument
when the string is stopped by a finger at the metal bar it will produce a note of the desired pitch
v. be agitated or irritated
zh: n. 烦躁, 磨损, 焦急, 网状饰物
vi. 烦恼, 不满, 磨损
vt. 使烦恼, 腐蚀, 使磨损, 使起波纹
examples: You need not fret over such trifles.
She spent the entire day fretting about the issue.

defsEn: v. praise somewhat dishonestly
zh: vt. 奉承, 阿谀, 使高兴
examples: The more he flatters, the less I like him.
A flattering friend is your worst enemy.
exampleZh: 他越是奉承我，我越觉得他讨厌。
只会说好听话的朋友,是你最可怕的敌人.

defsEn: n. a short trip that is taken in the performance of a necessary task or mission
zh: n. 任务, 差使, 使命
examples: Tom is out on an errand.
I have an errand I need to run.
exampleZh: Tom出去办事了。

defsEn: n. a flatbottom boat for carrying heavy loads (especially on canals)
v. push one's way
v. transport by barge on a body of water
zh: n. 驳船
vt. 用船运输
vi. 蹒跚, 闯入
examples: You can't just barge in here whenever you feel like it.
What is that black material in the barge?

defsEn: a. not conforming to accepted rules or standards
a. not conventional or conformist
zh: a. 不依惯例的, 非传统的, 非常规的
examples: It's an unconventional choice for some.
His unconventional lifestyle surprised his conservative family.

defsEn: n. loss of the ability to move a body part
zh: n. 麻痹, 停顿, 瘫痪
examples: Apathy is a paralysis of the soul, an early death.
Apathy is a paralysis of the soul, a premature death.

defsEn: n. (music) the speed at which a composition is to be played
n. the rate of some repeating event
zh: n. 速度, 节奏, 进行速度, (棋的)一着
examples: The tempo changed gradually toward the end of the symphony.
I like the slow tempo of this song.

defsEn: n. a commercial leavening agent containing yeast cells
used to raise the dough in making bread and for fermenting beer or whiskey
n. any of various single-celled fungi that reproduce asexually by budding or division
zh: n. 酵母
examples: We must add yeast to this dough.
Yeast will make the dough rise.

defsEn: n. a member of an uncivilized people
v. attack brutally and fiercely
v. criticize harshly or violently
zh: a. 未开化的, 野蛮的, 无礼的, 残酷的, 原始的, 粗鲁的, 未开发的
vt. 用暴力对付, 凶猛攻击
n. 原始人, 粗鲁人
examples: Savages fear the appearance of a fierce wild beast.
Savage says her idea to row across the Atlantic would embody those values.

defsEn: n. the heading or position of a vessel relative to the trim of its sails
n. a short nail with a sharp point and a large head
n. (nautical) the act of changing tack
n. sailing a zigzag course
zh: n. 平头钉, 大头钉, 粗缝针脚, 行动方针, 食物
vt. 以大头针钉住, 附加
examples: He tacked the thief to the ground.
To come down to brass tacks, you owe me something.

defsEn: n. any of numerous deciduous trees and shrubs of the genus Salix
n. a textile machine having a system of revolving spikes for opening and cleaning raw textile fibers
zh: n. 柳树, 柳木制品
a. 柳树的, 柳木制的
examples: The weeping willow only will weep.
This willow-tree looks like a mammoth.

defsEn: s. capable of being changed so as to match or fit
s. capable of being regulated
zh: a. 可调节的
examples: An adjustable wrench is a useful tool for any plumber.
The height of the chair is adjustable.

defsEn: n. vegetables (especially cucumbers) preserved in brine or vinegar
v. preserve in a pickling liquid
zh: n. 盐卤, 腌汁, 泡菜, 困境, 讨厌鬼
vt. 腌制, 酸洗, 葬送(机会等), 泡
examples: I found this pickle on the floor. Should I eat it?
Do you know how to pickle?

defsEn: s. standing still
s. not capable of being moved
zh: a. 不动的, 静止的, 不变的, 固定的, 停留的
examples: There was a stationary lorry in the middle of the road.
The albatross appeared to be stationary in the air.

defsEn: n. language or behavior intended to mock or humiliate

defsEn: n. Mexican revolutionary leader (1877-1923)

defsEn: n. a solution obtained by steeping or soaking a substance (usually in water)

divide into halves

You shouldn't do things by halves.

defsEn: a. gathered together or made less diffuse

s. without payment

defsEn: n the act of winding or twisting

and instance of groping

incapable of blending into a stable homogeneous mixture

enters into the structure of the atomic nucleus

s. providing abundant nourishment

acquired during fetal development

我们宁愿明天吃蜗牛。

defsEn: n. home symbolized as a part of the fireplace
n. an area near a fireplace (usually paved and extending out into a room)
zh: n. 炉床, 灶台, 炉边
examples: A fireplace is a family hearth, the alpha and omega of comfort and home.
Vesta was the goddess of the hearth and home.

defsEn: v. draw from specific cases for more general cases
v. speak or write in generalities
v. become systemic and spread throughout the body
zh: vt. 一般化, 概括, 推广
vi. 形成概念, 笼统讲
examples: Don't generalize individual behavior to an entire group.
You can't just generalize like that.
exampleZh: 不要把个人行为上升到集体。

defsEn: n. an electrical phenomenon whereby an electromotive force (EMF) is generated in a closed circuit by a change in the flow of current
n. the act of bringing about something (especially at an early time)
zh: n. 归纳法, 感应, 就职, 入门
examples: The rock star's induction into the Hall of Fame was predicted by all.
Induction cookers use magnets to directly heat pots and pans.

defsEn: s. favoring one person or side over another
zh: a. 有偏见的
examples: I know I may be biased.
We think our boy is brilliant. Of course, we might be biased.

defsEn: a. not worthy of reliance or trust
s. lacking a sense of responsibility
zh: a. 不可靠的
examples: Be cautious with him, he is an unreliable fellow.
A limited and unreliable electricity supply is a major impediment to economic development.

defsEn: n. one who stays for only a short time
n. (physics) a short-lived oscillation in a system caused by a sudden change of voltage or current or load
zh: n. 瞬, 短期居留者, 过境鸟, 瞬变现象
a. 短暂的, 易变的, 瞬变的, 路过的
examples: The life of a person is a transient thing.
Everything is transient and therefore sorrowful.

defsEn: n. a propelling force
n. the act of propelling
zh: n. 推进, 推进力
examples: The nautilus is a mollusk that uses jet propulsion to roam the ocean deep.
Rotating machines are essential in subsonic aeronautical propulsion.

defsEn: n. happening again (especially at regular intervals)
zh: n. 再现, 再发生, 反复, 循环
examples: The chances of recurrence vary from patient to patient.
There's a slight possibility of a recurrence.

defsEn: a. relating to or constituting or bearing or giving a name
s. insignificantly small
a matter of form only (`tokenish' is informal)
a. pertaining to a noun or to a word group that functions as a noun
a. of, relating to, or characteristic of an amount that is not adjusted for inflation
zh: a. 名义上的, 名字的, 有名无实的, 稍许的
n. 名词性词
examples: Price increases explain the difference between the real and nominal growth rates.
Japan fans may like the article "Ergativity and Bare Nominals in Early Old Japanese."
exampleZh: 日本文化爱好者可能会喜欢《早期古日文中的作格与裸名词》这篇文章。

defsEn: s. worthy of notice or attention
zh: a. 著名的, 显著的, 扬名的
examples: If you use the quit command noted below, you can make the application exit.
You have a complicated name. I noted it so as not to forget it.

defsEn: n. sealed vessel where water is converted to steam
zh: n. 煮器, 汽锅, 锅炉
examples: The boiler room contains the heating equipment used to distribute heat throughout the mall.
I forgot to turn on the boiler before taking a shower.

defsEn: n. an attack that penetrates into enemy territory
n. clear or deep perception of a situation
n. the act of entering into or through something
zh: n. 穿透, 渗透, 侵入, 识穿, 洞察(力)
examples: I was born in the wrong penetration.

defsEn: n. the act of giving an account describing incidents or a course of events
n. (rhetoric) the second section of an oration in which the facts are set forth
zh: n. 叙述, 故事, 叙述文
examples: Narrations can be analysed in terms of point of view.

defsEn: n. bitter conflict
heated often violent dissension
zh: n. 争吵, 竞争, 冲突
examples: Strife is the rock on which the party split.
Jealousy and strife have overthrown great cities, and rooted up mighty nations.

defsEn: n. a channel along the eaves or on the roof
collects and carries away rainwater
n. misfortune resulting in lost effort or money
n. a worker who guts things (fish or buildings or cars etc.)
n. a tool for gutting fish
zh: n. 排水沟, 槽, 贫民区
vt. 开沟于
vi. 流
examples: Get your mind out of the gutter.
Get your mind out of the gutter!

defsEn: n. (psychology) an erroneous belief that is held in the face of evidence to the contrary
n. a mistaken or unfounded opinion or idea
n. the act of deluding
deception by creating illusory ideas
zh: n. 迷惑, 欺瞒, 错觉
examples: Delusions could be a part of a mental disorder.
They're living in a world of delusion.

defsEn: v. combine so as to form a more complex, product
v. combine and form a synthesis
zh: v. 综合, 合成
examples: The lab is trying to synthesize an antidote to treat the poisoning victims.
Adrenochrome is not psychoactive and is easily synthesized.

defsEn: v. make solid or more solid
cause to solidify
v. become solid
zh: v. (使)凝固, (使)团结, 巩固
examples: Islam solidified its place in the Sahara during the Middle Ages.
Kalman solidified his control of the country.

defsEn: v. put out or expel from a place
v. leave an aircraft rapidly, using an ejection seat or capsule
zh: vt. 逐放, 放逐, 喷射
examples: The computer told Lukas to eject.
The pilot ejected from his plane.

defsEn: n. the quality of being open and truthful
not deceitful or hypocritical
n. a quality of naturalness and simplicity
zh: n. 诚实, 真实, 诚心诚意
examples: I have no doubt as to his sincerity.
If you question her sincerity, do not ask for her help.

defsEn: n. a law officer having duties similar to those of a sheriff in carrying out the judgments of a court of law
n. (in some countries) a military officer of highest rank
v. place in proper rank
v. arrange in logical order
zh: n. 元帅, 陆空军高级将官, 典礼官, 执法官
vt. 整理, 引领, 统率
vi. 排列, 各就各位
examples: I will marshal a fair amount of scientific data to support my argument.
The field marshal leads an entire army.

defsEn: n. one whose presence is undesirable
a. not wanted
s. not worthy of being chosen (especially as a spouse)
zh: a. 不受欢迎的, 不合乎社会道德标准的
examples: That girl has an extremely undesirable personality.
Clinginess is an undesirable quality in a romantic partner.

defsEn: n. the early stage of growth or development
n. the earliest state of immaturity
zh: n. 幼年, 初期, 幼儿期
examples: Our project is still in its infancy.
My infancy was more than happy.

defsEn: n. disorderly fighting
zh: n. 激烈而持久的争论
vi. 争论
vt. 与...争辩, 使烦恼
examples: It's become a hassle to keep on dyeing my hair.
That's a bit of a hassle.
exampleZh: 一直染发太麻烦了。

defsEn: a. of or relating to metabolism
a. undergoing metamorphosis
zh: a. 变化的, 变形的, 新陈代谢的
examples: To assess metabolic health, doctors measure blood sugar, cholesterol, blood pressure and other indicators.

defsEn: r. continuing forever without end
zh: adv. 无限地, 无数地, 庞大地
examples: Allow your imagination to be infinitely free.
I'm infinitely grateful for your help.

defsEn: s. mean and unworthy and despicable
zh: a. 衣衫褴褛的, 低劣的, 破旧的, 吝啬的, 卑鄙的
examples: In the end, we ended up eating at that shabby restaurant.
Get out, shabby! Why be so envious, you who are so old?
exampleZh: 结果，我们在那破破烂烂的餐馆里吃了饭。

defsEn: n. someone who censures or condemns
n. a person who is authorized to read publications or correspondence or to watch theatrical performances and suppress in whole or in part anything considered obscene or politically unacceptable
v. subject to political, religious, or moral censorship
zh: n. 检查员
vt. 检查, 审查, 删改
examples: It'd be very convenient if we could censor this kind of comment.
How can the West totally censor Islam on the Internet?

defsEn: v. treat with contemptuous disregard
zh: n. 嘲笑, 愚弄, 笑柄, 食品
v. 嘲笑, 嘲弄, 贪吃, 狼吞虎咽地吃
examples: You'll never convince them if you scoff at and insult them.
To our surprise, he scoffed the lot.

defsEn: n. an officer charged with receiving and disbursing funds
zh: n. 会计, 出纳员, 司库
examples: She serves as the club treasurer.
Pay your dues to the treasurer.

defsEn: n. most favorable conditions or greatest degree or amount possible under given circumstances
s. most desirable possible under a restriction expressed or implied
zh: n. 最适条件, 最佳效果
a. 最优的, 最适宜的
examples: Finding the optimum for a numerical function can be an important challenge.
Tom writes in Esperanto for optimum expressiveness.

defsEn: n. the period of European history at the close of the Middle Ages and the rise of the modern world
a cultural rebirth from the 14th through the middle of the 17th centuries
zh: n. 复活, 复兴, 文艺复兴
a. 文艺复兴的
examples: With Renaissance, scholastic ideas gave place to positive ideas.
The fairy at the Renaissance festival was actually a real fairy.
exampleZh: 随著文艺复兴，学院派的想法被积极的想法取而代之了。

defsEn: s marked by practical hardheaded intelligence
s used of persons
zh: a. 精明的, 锐利的, 剧烈的, 机灵的, 厉害的
examples: Tom was a shrewd businessman and his company went from strength to strength.
I know that Tom is a very shrewd businessman.

defsEn: n. (philosophy) the philosophical theory that ideas are the only reality
n. impracticality by virtue of thinking of things in their ideal form rather than as they really are
zh: n. 唯心主义, 观念论, 唯心论, 理想主义
examples: The idealism of American bourgeois philosophers is aggressive and warlike.
Idealism has always been and remains a philosophy serving the conservative and reactionary classes.

defsEn: n. a lay judge or civil authority who administers the law (especially one who conducts a court dealing with minor offenses)
zh: n. 长官, 法官, 推事
examples: The magistrate disqualified himself from hearing the case because of a conflict of interest.
The defender finished, the magistrate said he had nothing to declare.

defsEn: n. a thief who enters a building with intent to steal
zh: n. 窃贼
examples: The burglar shut the child in the closet.
The police think the burglar entered through a basement window.
exampleZh: 强盗把小孩关在了衣柜里。
警察认为窃贼从地下室窗口进入。

defsEn: n a surrounding or nearby region
zh: n. 地方, 所在, 位置
examples: I know both the localities very well.
The locality does not count for much in Japan.

defsEn: n. something that is required in advance
s. required as a prior condition or course of study
zh: a. 先决条件的, 必要的
n. 先决条件, 必备条件
examples: What are the prerequisites for a child to learn the piano?
The basic prerequisite for every progress is the conviction that the necessary is possible.
exampleZh: 孩子学钢琴要具备哪些条件？

defsEn: n. a route shorter than the usual one
zh: n. 捷径, 最短路线
examples: There is no shortcut to success.
This is the shortcut that I usually take to school.
exampleZh: 成功是没有捷径的。
这通常是我去学校的捷径。

defsEn: s. shunning contact with others
just shy"
s. hostile to or disruptive of normal standards of social behavior
zh: 不爱社交的, 反社会的, 有害于公众利益的
examples: I may be antisocial, but it doesn't mean I don't talk to people.
There's nothing wrong with antisocial people.
exampleZh: 我或许不善于社交,但这并不意味我不和别人交谈。

defsEn: n. a nobleman (in various countries) of varying rank
n. a British peer of the lowest rank
n. a very wealthy or powerful businessman
zh: n. 男爵
examples: I thought that you were a baron.
Knights acted as a counterpoise to the barons.

defsEn: n the branch of molecular biology that studies the use of microorganisms to perform specific industrial processes
zh: n. 生物技术
examples: Sami was a business manager at a biotech company.
Biotech and Moderna have a lead in the Corona or Covid vaccination.

defsEn: n. calmness without winds
zh: n. 静止, 沉静
examples: I find wisdom in the stillness of the morning.
I find peace in the stillness of the morning light.

defsEn: v. cause (a chemical compound, vapour, solution, magnetic material) to unite with the greatest possible amount of another substance
zh: vt. 使渗透, 浸透, 使充满, 使饱和
a. 浸透的, 饱和度高的, 深颜色的
n. 饱和化合物, 饱和脂肪酸
examples: The wood has become saturated with water.
The ground is saturated with salt.

defsEn: r. in a uniform manner
zh: adv. 一样, 一致, 相同, 一直不变, 一贯, 始终如一, 均质, 一律, 均匀
examples: Colonel Barclay's family life appears to have been a uniformly happy one.
Continue stirring until the chocolate chips are mixed uniformly through the cookie dough.

defsEn: a. all of the same or similar kind or nature
zh: a. 同种的, 同质的, 齐性的
examples: Any homogeneous cycle has a period and a frequency.
They want a linguistically homogeneous country.

defsEn: v. cause to move back by force or influence
v. be repellent to
cause aversion in
v. force or drive back
zh: vt. 逐退, 抵制, 使厌恶, 抗御
vi. 使厌恶, 相互排斥
examples: The scent of cedar repels moths.
The people could repel the invasion.
exampleZh: 雪松的气味可以驱赶飞蛾。

defsEn: n time without end
zh: n. 无限大, 无限
examples: I love you infinity to the power of infinity.
Can infinity be an imaginary number?

defsEn: n. refined taste
tact
n. smallness of stature
n. subtly skillful handling of a situation
zh: n. 细软, 精致, 精美的食品, 娇气, 微妙, 棘手, 娇弱, 灵敏, 灵巧
examples: It is certainly a tasty delicacy. To all of you I say "bon appetit."
I am eating a chewy local delicacy.

defsEn: a. situated away from an area's coast or border
r. towards or into the interior of a region
zh: a. 内陆的, 国内的
n. 内地
examples: And me, I was born in a nondescript town in the inland.
We're too far inland to see any seagulls yet.

defsEn: s. repetitive and persistent
zh: a. 坚持的, 迫切的
examples: The salesman was insistent to the end.
Why are you so insistent on going with me?

defsEn: n. used as a lubricant and as a moderator in nuclear reactors
zh: n. 石墨
examples: Only oil of the best quality and pure graphite should be used.
Two kinds of lubricant are used on a bicycle--oil and graphite.

defsEn: n. the trait of behaving in ways considered typical for men
zh: n. 男子气, 刚毅, 大丈夫气概
examples: I think hairiness is a symbol of masculinity, so I really like it.
His masculinity feels questioned by your presence.

defsEn: v make a subtraction
v retain and refrain from disbursing
of payments
v reason by deduction
establish by deduction
zh: vt. 扣除, 减去
examples: He could deduct the furnishing of his work room from his taxes.
Ziri deducted four thousand dinars from the bill.

defsEn: n. the feeling that accompanies something extremely surprising
zh: n. 惊异, 惊愕, 使人惊异的事物
examples: To my astonishment, my money was gone.
Between astonishment and sorrow, she could not speak a word.
exampleZh: 令我惊讶的是，我的钱没了。

defsEn: n. the sound of heavy treading or stomping
v. injure by trampling or as if by trampling
zh: n. 践踏(声), 蹂躏
v. 践踏, 无视
examples: The children trampled on the grass and the guard scolded them.
We're tired of being trampled on by the West.

defsEn: n. a meeting or conference for the public discussion of some topic especially one in which the participants form an audience and make presentations
zh: n. 讨论会, 座谈会, 专题报告会, 专题论文集
examples: Tom is attending a writers' symposium in Boston.

defsEn: s lacking refinement or cultivation or taste
s of or associated with the great masses of people
s being or characteristic of or appropriate to everyday language
s conspicuously and tastelessly indecent
zh: a. 粗俗的, 庸俗的, 普通的, 通俗的, 方言的
examples: She is extremely vulgar in her speech.
You could say it that way, but it's quite vulgar.
exampleZh: 她讲话非常俗气。
可以这样说，但是太不文明了。

defsEn: n. the inner and usually edible part of a seed or grain or nut or fruit stone
n. a single whole grain of a cereal
n. the choicest or most essential or most vital part of some idea or experience
zh: n. 核心, 中心, 精髓, 内核
examples: He that will eat the kernel, must crack the nut.
There could be a kernel of truth behind this legend.

defsEn: n. nutritive material of an ovum stored for the nutrition of an embryo (especially the yellow mass of a bird or reptile egg)
zh: n. 蛋黄, 卵黄
examples: Separate the yolk from the egg.
He separated the yolk from the white.

defsEn: n. any placental mammal of the order Primates
has good eyesight and flexible hands and feet
zh: n. 大主教, 灵长目动物
examples: The primates include not only the apes, but also man.
Madame Berthe's mouse lemur is the smallest primate in the world.

defsEn: n. a person (such as an author) of enduring fame
a. not subject to death
zh: n. 不朽人物, 神仙
a. 永远的, 不死的, 长久的
examples: No one of us is immortal.
There has never been a savior nor an immortal emperor to rely on.
exampleZh: 没有人是不朽的。
从来就没有什么救世主， 也不靠神仙皇帝！

defsEn: a. aggressively self-assured
zh: a. 武断的, 过分自信的
examples: How do I become assertive with my dog?
You need to learn how to be assertive.

defsEn: n the state of being pregnant
the period from conception to birth when a woman carries a developing fetus in her uterus
n the kinship relation between an offspring and the mother
n the quality of having or showing the tenderness and warmth and affection of or befitting a mother
zh: n. 母性, 怀孕, 妇产科医院
a. 产妇的
examples: She will start her maternity leave next week.
After her maternity leave, she resumed her old job.

defsEn: n a forest with heavy annual rainfall
zh: 雨林
examples: Tropical rainforests produce oxygen and consume carbon dioxide.
The rainforest was cut down and replaced by a palm oil plantation.

defsEn: n. a swimming kick used while treading water
v. give a thrashing to
beat hard
v. beat so fast that (the heart's) output starts dropping until (it) does not manage to pump out blood at all
v. move data into and out of core rather than performing useful computation
zh: vt. 打, 使逆行, 胜过, 推敲, 鞭打
vi. 打谷, 痛打, 剧烈扭动, 逆行
n. 打谷, (划水)鞭状动作
examples: The rock band thrashed the hotel room.
We got thrashed at the match today.

defsEn: v. make longer
v. become long or longer
zh: vt. 加长, 使延长
vi. 变长
examples: Being optimistic could lengthen your life, a new study suggests.
Sadness lengthens life; happiness shortens it.

defsEn: n. a grain of barley
n. cultivated since prehistoric times
grown for forage and grain
zh: n. 大麦
examples: Can you tell barley from wheat at first sight?
Can you distinguish barley from wheat?

defsEn: n. correspondence in form or appearance
n. acting according to certain accepted standards
n. orthodoxy in thoughts and belief
zh: n. 遵照, 适合, 一致, 相似
examples: Conformity is an essential element of our homogeneous community.
It's a simple matter of conformity.

defsEn: n. a deliberately false or improbable account
n. writing in a fictional form
n. the act of making something (a product) from raw materials
zh: n. 制造, 建造, 虚构的谎言
examples: To call that fabrication a fib would be a criminal understatement.
Everything he told us was pure fabrication.

defsEn: a oblivious of dangers or perils or calmly resolute in facing them
s invulnerable to fear or intimidation
zh: a. 大胆的, 勇敢的, 无畏的
examples: The gulls tend to be seemingly fearless when it comes to stealing food.
Kalman always portrayed himself as the fearless leader type.

defsEn: a. in the same direction as the rotating hands of a clock
r. in the direction that the hands of a clock move
zh: a. 顺时针方向的
adv. 顺时针方向地
examples: You must turn the faucet clockwise to close it.
It moves in a clockwise motion.

defsEn: s. causing one to believe what is not true or fail to believe what is true
s. designed to deceive or mislead either deliberately or inadvertently
zh: a. 迷惑的, 虚伪的, 欺诈的
examples: There is nothing more deceptive than an obvious fact.
The weather is deceptive in spring.

defsEn: s. in a condition of biological rest or suspended animation
a. (of e.g. volcanos) not erupting and not extinct
s. lying with head on paws as if sleeping
zh: a. 睡眠状态的, 静止的
examples: At the end of the sleep the dormant awakes.
Is there dormant life on Mars?

defsEn: n. case for holding arrows
v. shake with fast, tremulous movements
zh: n. 震动, 颤抖, 箭袋
vi. 颤抖, 振动
vt. 使颤动
a. 敏捷的
examples: The leaves quivered in the breeze.
Her voice was quivering with anger.
exampleZh: 树叶在微风中颤动。
她的声音因愤怒而颤抖。

defsEn: n. a British peer of the highest rank
n. a nobleman (in various countries) of high rank
zh: n. 公爵
examples: The duke raised his glass in a toast to the queen.
The duke extended his hand for the dance.

defsEn: s showing inventiveness and skill
zh: a. 灵敏的, 精巧的, 聪明的
examples: The ingenious man received the prestigious award for the first time.
Ingenious solutions often capture our attention because of their simplicity.

defsEn: v. make understand
v. give spiritual insight to
in religion
zh: vt. 教育, 启发, 启蒙, 开导, 教导
examples: He enlightened me on how I should attack the subject.
An enlightened mind should be able to entertain any position without committing to it.

defsEn: n. the physical property of being inflexible and hard to bend
n. the property of moving with pain or difficulty
n. firm resoluteness in purpose or opinion or action
zh: n. 坚硬, 呆板, 刻板
examples: She stretched to relieve the stiffness in her back.

defsEn: n a loud utterance
often in protest or opposition
v shout louder than
v utter aloud
often with surprise, horror, or joy
zh: n. 尖叫, 倒彩, 强烈抗议, 喊价
vi. 喊叫
vt. 叫得比...响
examples: To address the public outcry, the president held a press conference.
The outcries of the angels go unheard by ordinary human ears.

defsEn: s impossible to avoid or evade:"inescapable conclusion"
zh: a. 不可避免的, 不得已的, 不能作废的
examples: Death is an unavoidable aspect of life.
Due to unavoidable circumstances this summer I can't stay in my holiday cottage.

defsEn: n. any tiny hole admitting passage of a liquid (fluid or gas)
n. any small opening in the skin or outer surface of an animal
zh: n. 毛孔, 小孔, 气孔
vi. 专心阅读, 细想, 钻研, 沉思, 注视
vt. 使注视得
examples: Virgilius was fond of books, and pored over them all day long.
Nadia pored over the book, enthralled by its author's expansive vocabulary and nuanced writing.

defsEn: n adult male chicken
zh: n. 公鸡, 栖息的鸟
examples: The rooster wants to take on the eagle.
The rooster is very brave in his yard.

defsEn: n. an irrational belief arising from ignorance or fear
zh: n. 迷信
examples: Such a ridiculous superstition no longer exists.
Religion is just organised superstition with a bestseller.
exampleZh: 这种荒谬的迷信已不复存在了。
宗教不过是有组织的迷信加上一本畅销书。

defsEn: n. the property of being ingenious
zh: n. 心灵手巧, 精巧, 精巧设计
examples: Gabriel survived using his ingenuity and determination.

defsEn: n. a cruel and oppressive dictator
n. in ancient Greece, a ruler who had seized power without legal right to it

vi. 打喷嚏
examples: I've seen our dog sneeze, but not our cat.
When you sneeze, it means someone is thinking of you.
exampleZh: 我见过我家的狗打喷嚏，但是从来没见过我家的猫打喷嚏。
打喷嚏是因为有人在想你。

defsEn: n. an imaginary line around the Earth forming the great circle that is equidistant from the north and south poles
n. a circle dividing a sphere or other surface into two usually equal and symmetrical parts
zh: n. 赤道
examples: I crossed the equator for the first time on my trip to Australia.
That ship crossed the equator yesterday.
exampleZh: 我去澳大利亚旅游的时候第一次穿越了赤道。
那条船昨天穿过了赤道。

defsEn: a. that may be permitted especially as according to rule
s. that may be accepted or conceded
zh: a. 可允许的, 可容许程度的
examples: This is not permissible in Islam.
Is it ever morally permissible to lie?

defsEn: a. having or showing or expressing reverence for a deity
zh: a. 虔诚的, 敬神的, 尽责的, 可嘉的, 不可能实现的
examples: So characteristic of what a pious Christian would say, this courteous phrase.
Although I am a pious man, I am not the less a man.

defsEn: n. (astronomy) an arbitrarily fixed date that is the point in time relative to which information (as coordinates of a celestial body) is recorded
n. a unit of geological time that is a subdivision of a period and is itself divided into ages
zh: n. 新纪元, 时代, 时期
examples: His description of that epoch is fascinating.
His description of the epoch is fascinating.

defsEn: s. inadequate in amount or degree
s. falling short of some prescribed norm
zh: a. 不足的, 不充分的, 有缺陷的
examples: The young engineer was deficient in experience.
My car is deficient in horsepower.

defsEn: n. a mill that is powered by the wind
n. generator that extracts usable energy from winds
zh: n. 风车
examples: In Netherlands you can see windmills wherever you go.
I had never seen a windmill until I visited the Netherlands.
exampleZh: 在荷兰随你走到哪里都见得到风车。
在我去荷兰之前，我从没见过风车。

defsEn: s showing a brooding ill humor
s darkened by clouds
zh: a. 愠怒的, 沉闷的, 阴沉的
examples: She had a sullen look on her face.
He became sullen and grumpy over time.

defsEn: a. conducive to or characteristic of physical or moral well-being
s. sound or exhibiting soundness in body or mind
zh: a. 有益健康的, 合乎卫生的, 健全的, 有益的, 有生气的, 审慎的
examples: She prepares wholesome meals for her family.
Beyond a wholesome discipline, be gentle with yourself.
exampleZh: 她为她的家人准备健康餐。

defsEn: v. cause to suffer
zh: vt. 迫害, 虐待, 困扰, 同...捣乱
examples: He persecuted people for their religion.
He said that he felt persecuted.

defsEn: a. tending to squander and waste
s. laying waste
zh: a. 浪费的, 不经济的
examples: It's wasteful to leave the land lying idle.
We need to cut wasteful spending.
exampleZh: 让土地闲置着很浪费。

defsEn: n. a mental state of extreme emotional disturbance
n. a state of agitation or turbulent change or development
n. the feeling of being agitated
not calm
zh: n. 激动, 焦虑, 煽动, 搅动, 摇动
examples: His agitation was so great that he could hardly speak.
Her agitation was so great that she could hardly speak.

defsEn: r. (formal) in or into that thing or place
zh: adv. 在其中, 在那里, 在那一点上
examples: Those who dig a grave for others will fall therein.
Those who dig a grave for others will themselves fall therein.

defsEn: n. a condensed but memorable saying embodying some important fact of experience that is taken as true by many people
zh: n. 谚语, 格言, 箴言
vt. 使众所周知, 用谚语表达
examples: In Wales we have a proverb.
I gave all of the Chinese proverbs back to the teacher.
exampleZh: 在威尔斯，我们有一个句谚语。
我把成语全部还给老师了。

defsEn: n. an appraisal that is too high
n. a calculation that results in an estimate that is too high
v. make too high an estimate of
zh: vt. 评价过高, 过高估价
n. 估计过高, 评价过高
examples: We cannot overestimate the value of health.
It's hardly possible to overestimate the political significance of Turkey in this region.
exampleZh: 我们不能高估健康的价值。

defsEn: n. a feeling of sympathetic understanding
n. capability of existing or performing in harmonious or congenial combination
zh: n. 兼容性
examples: Interoperability means compatibility with other systems.

defsEn: s too numerous to be counted
zh: a. 无数的, 数不清的
examples: I have tried innumerable times to contact him.
The leaves of the tree are innumerable.
exampleZh: 我找过他很多次。

defsEn: a. capable of being reached only with great difficulty or not at all
s. not capable of being obtained
zh: a. 难得到的, 难接近的, 难达成的
examples: This part of Kabylie is a wild and inaccessible land.
This area of Algeria is largely inaccessible.

defsEn: n. the act of lodging
zh: n. 寄宿处, 寄宿
examples: You get free lodging in prison.
This little house is my lodging.

defsEn: n. (physics) the tendency of a body to maintain its state of rest or uniform motion unless acted upon by an external force
zh: n. 惯性, 惰性, 迟钝
examples: He continued to live as if by inertia.
She continued to live as if by inertia.

defsEn: s more than is needed, desired, or required
s repetition of same sense in different words
zh: a. 多余的, 过多的, 冗长的
examples: I'm sorry to have to tell you that you've been made redundant.
This sentence has a lot of redundant words.
exampleZh: 非常不幸地通知您，您被辞退了。

defsEn: n. an explosive device that is set off in an oil well (or a gas well) to start or to increase the flow of oil (or gas)
n. a small firework that consists of a percussion cap and some gravel wrapped in paper
explodes when thrown forcefully against a hard surface
n. a small explosive device that is placed on a railroad track and fires when a train runs over it
the sound of the explosion warns the engineer of danger ahead
n. armament consisting of a long cylindrical self-propelled underwater projectile that detonates on contact with a target
zh: n. 鱼雷, 水雷, 地雷
vt. 用鱼雷袭击, 破坏
examples: One of the torpedoes hit its target.
A torpedo is an underwater missile.

defsEn: n. a publication that appears at fixed intervals
zh: n. 期刊
a. 定期出版的, (有关)期刊的, 间歇(性的), 周期的, 定期的
examples: Which of these periodicals would you prefer?
The periodical costs less than the book.

defsEn: n. someone who holds shares of stock in a corporation
zh: n. 股东
examples: I'm a stockholder in this company.
The stockholders are making money hand over fist.

defsEn: v. happen or occur again
v. return in thought or speech to something
zh: vi. 复发, 回到, 重现, 再来, 诉诸, 采用, 循环
examples: Did you ever have a recurring dream?
Next year we'll recur to this issue.
exampleZh: 你有过一个你会重复做的梦吗？

defsEn: n. a concise reference book providing specific information about a subject or location
zh: n. 手册
examples: This new gardening handbook could be a useful resource for plant lovers.
The school handbook lists impermissible forms of protest on campus.

defsEn: n. (logic) a proposition that is accepted as true in order to provide a basis for logical reasoning
v. take as a given
assume as a postulate or axiom
zh: n. 假定, 基本条件
vt. 要求, 假定
examples: We need to postulate a completely different paradigm to explain all these phenomena.

defsEn: s (of a body of water) free from disturbance by heavy waves
s not agitated
without losing self-possession
zh: a. 安静的
examples: It was very tranquil in the mosque.
The city is tranquil at night.

defsEn: n. a polyhedron with two congruent and parallel faces (the bases) and whose lateral faces are parallelograms
n. optical device having a triangular shape and made of glass or quartz
used to deviate a beam or invert an image
zh: n. 棱镜, 棱柱

Light is resolved by a prism into seven colors.

defsEn: a. having the nature of or resulting from malice
zh: a. 怀恶意的, 恶毒的

Malicious joy is the best joy.

defsEn: v evaluate or estimate the nature, quality, ability, extent, or significance of
v consider in a comprehensive way

examples: An expert appraised the value of the watch as two hundred dollars.
Tom had the painting appraised by an expert before he bought it.

defsEn: s. outside the regular academic curriculum
s. outside the regular duties of your job or profession
zh: a. 课外的, 业余的

What extracurricular activities are you involved in?

defsEn: n a state of commotion and noise and confusion
n loud confused noise from many sources
zh: n. 骚动, 喧嚣
examples: The whole town was in an uproar.
This has caused a huge uproar in the city.

defsEn: n. a shaft on which a wheel rotates
zh: n. 轴, 车轴
examples: The axle of the car wobbled and would soon cause further damage.
The axle is out of true.

defsEn: v. cause to conform to standard or norm
v. evaluate by comparing with a standard
zh: vt. 使标准化, 使合于标准, 用标准检验
examples: It's difficult to standardize language for a multi-ethnic nation.
Hindi and Urdu are standardized varieties of the Hindustani language.

defsEn: n. the place where two or more things come together
n. the state of being joined together
n. something that joins or connects
n. an act of joining or adjoining things
zh: n. 连接, 会合处, 交叉点
examples: The junction box allows you to store the camera's pigtail inside of it.
Drive to the next junction and turn left.
exampleZh: 接线盒可以用来存放摄影机的尾线。

defsEn: n. an embarrassing mistake
zh: n. 大错, 大失策
vi. 失策, 跌跌撞撞地走, 犯错
vt. 做错
examples: I am not responsible to you for my blunder.
I wonder if we made a blunder.

defsEn: n. a person who installs or repairs electrical or telephone lines
zh: n. 电学家, 电气技师, 电工
examples: Next week, the electrician will come and fix the cable.
The electrician will come and fix the cable next week.

defsEn: n. the act of puncturing with a small point
v. cause a stinging pain
v. to cause a sharp emotional pain
zh: vt. 刺, 戳, 刺痛, 使竖起
vi. 刺, 竖起
n. 扎, 一刺, 刺痛
a. 竖起的
examples: If you prick us, do we not bleed?
You can be a bit of a prick sometimes.
exampleZh: 你们要是用刀剑刺向我们，我们难道不会流血吗？

defsEn: n. United States neoclassical composer (1894-1976)
n. mechanical device that has a plunging or thrusting motion

This shaft links with a piston.

n. a mechanism consisting of a metal honeycomb through which hot fluids circulate
heat is transferred from the fluid through the honeycomb to the airstream that is created either by the motion of the vehicle or by a fan
zh: n. 暖气装置, 散热器, 辐射体

r. near or toward the bow of a ship or cockpit of a plane

Daniel sat down at the fore table.

defsEn: a. below the required standards for a purpose
a. not in good physical or mental condition
out of condition
zh: a. 不适当的, 不胜任的, 不健康的
vt. 使不相宜, 使不合格
examples: He is unfit to be a teacher.
They consider him unfit for that job.
exampleZh: 他不适合当老师。

zh: n. 陷窟, 裂口

We're starting our descent into the chasm.

a fictitious reason that is concocted in order to conceal the real reason

v. 以...为借口

Jonas left under the pretext of going to the bathroom.
exampleZh: 他打着见我的幌子来了我家。
乔纳斯以去洗手间为借口离开了。

zh: n. 恶意, 蓄意害人, 怨恨
examples: There was no malice intended in what she said.
Never attribute to malice that which is adequately explained by stupidity.
exampleZh: 她的话没有恶意。
能解释为愚蠢的，就不要解释为恶意。

zh: n. 饱和, 渗透, 浸透, 色饱和度

v. cause to seem more splendid

有没有没有元音的语言？

We'll make you get over your melancholy.

zh: n. 碳氢化合物

Hydrocarbons continue to play a fundamental role in Algeria's economy.

examples: The rain clattered on the roof of the bus shelter.
What clatter is that in the courtyard?

zh: a. 对称的, 匀称的

It needs to be perfectly symmetrical.

s. prepared to agree or consent
zh: a. 令人愉快的, 同意的
examples: He could make himself agreeable to almost anyone.

zh: n. 进口, 插入物

v. abuse with coarse language
zh: n. 俚语

entreat

zh: a. 久坐的, 坐惯的, 定栖的
examples: I need a lot more protein than a sedentary person.
Many people lead a sedentary life, which can lead to weight gain.

defsEn: n. the stalk of a stamen
n. a threadlike structure (as a chainlike series of cells)
n. a thin wire (usually tungsten) that is heated white hot by the passage of an electric current
zh: n. 细丝, 细线, 灯丝, 单纤维
examples: You can see the filament inside the light bulb.
A new spool of filament has been delivered.

defsEn: n. a long stiff hair growing from the snout or brow of most mammals as e.g. a cat
zh: n. 腮须, 胡须, 一丝儿
examples: I woke up with cat whiskers in my face.
The cat's white whiskers twitched as it stalked its prey.

defsEn: v. be persistent, refuse to stop
zh: vi. 坚持, 孜孜不倦, 不屈不挠, (辩论中)固执己见

defsEn: n. (poetic) tranquil silence

v. cause to be quiet or not talk
v. wash by removing particles
zh: n. 肃静, 安静, 沉默
vt. (使)肃静, (使)安静, (使)缄默
interj. 嘘, 别作声
examples: Hush up and finish your work.

vt. 反击, 反驳, 蒸馏
examples: He was tempted to retort, but thought better of it.
He retorted that it was all my fault.

n. a state of declining economic condition
n. a sound property that is free from loudness or stridency
zh: n. 柔和, 温柔

They enjoyed the softness and sweetness of the buns.

v. have no limits as a mathematical series
v. extend in a different direction

vt. 使岔开

defsEn: n. a state of deterioration in metals caused by oxidation or chemical action
n. erosion by chemical action
zh: n. 腐蚀, 侵蚀, 腐蚀产生的物质, 铁锈, 锈
examples: She noticed rust and corrosion in the pipes under her kitchen sink.

defsEn: v. be larger in number, quantity, power, status or importance

defsEn: n. state of being torn or burst open

zh: n. 破裂, 断裂, 裂开, 决裂, 不和

n. the quantity a flask will hold
zh: n. 细颈瓶, 烧瓶, 小水瓶

Obviously, we don't know if those thermos flasks are their own.

当然，那些热水瓶是不是他们自己的就不得而知了。

defsEn: n. the failure to obey

Direct sun could scorch the leaves of the ivy.

zh: n. 共和国；联邦；国民整体

zh: n. 马克思主义
